jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you'll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

What success looks like

  • A clear, integrated programme plan that connects workstreams, milestones, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Predictable, well-controlled delivery, with risks anticipated, blockers resolved and commitments actively managed.
  • Clear accountability across workstreams and strong alignment between clients, partners and delivery teams.
  • Timely, informed decision-making supported by transparent reporting and a reliable view of programme performance.
  • Measurable client outcomes, with clear evidence of adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • A programme that meets its objectives while adapting effectively as priorities and requirements evolve.

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

 

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
  • Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
  • Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
  • Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
  • Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

 

What You Must Have

  • Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
  • Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
  • Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
  • Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
  • Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
  • Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

* This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. 

* We do not partner with search firms.

 

About The Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team and help drive Lokalise's growth across one of our most commercially significant segments.

The customers you'll engage span a broad range of industries across EMEA — from high-growth tech companies and digital-native brands to more established businesses undergoing meaningful transformation. These are companies at genuine inflection points: some are taking their first structured steps into localisation, moving away from fragmented, agency-reliant processes; others are further along, looking to consolidate tooling, automate workflows end-to-end, and unlock the full potential of AI-assisted translation at scale.

AI is increasingly at the centre of these conversations. Prospects want to understand how intelligent automation can accelerate time-to-market, reduce manual review cycles, and enable their teams to scale content globally without scaling headcount — and you'll be equipped to lead those conversations with real credibility, backed by a platform that is purpose-built for this moment in the industry.

Reporting into EMEA Sales leadership, you'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, collaborating closely with Sales Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to position Lokalise as a trusted, long-term partner for growth.

 

What You Will Do 

  • Manage the full sales cycle: From prospecting and identifying qualified leads to delivering compelling product demonstrations, navigating proof-of-concept processes, and negotiating contracts.
  • Engage prospects: Position and articulate Lokalise's value proposition to key decision-makers, ensuring alignment with their business needs and objectives.
  • Build a robust pipeline: Commit to daily targeted outbound prospecting to consistently maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams: Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure a seamless customer journey and tailor solutions to prospect needs.
  • Exceed sales targets: Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue quotas while driving long-term relationships with customers.
  • Track and report sales activities: Maintain up-to-date records in Salesforce and provide accurate forecasting and account planning.
  • Stay informed: Continuously educate yourself on Lokalise's products, the localisation industry, and competitive landscape to effectively position our solutions.


What You Must Have 

  • Proven sales experience: 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, preferably managing complex sales cycles with mid-market and enterprise clients.
  • Track record of success: Demonstrable history of meeting or exceeding quotas and closing new business.
  • Outbound prospecting and pipeline generation: Proven ability to proactively identify and engage target accounts, generate your own pipeline through outbound outreach, and turn cold prospects into qualified opportunities. You're comfortable taking ownership of prospecting rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or SDR-generated pipeline.
  • Experience selling to Marketing teams: A track record of selling SaaS solutions to Marketing audiences. Given the technical complexity of our product, experience engaging with technical stakeholders and navigating product-focused conversations is also a plus.
  • Sales methodology expertise: Familiarity with methodologies like SPICED, MEDDIC, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities, with the capability to engage and influence multiple stakeholders.
  • Technical aptitude: Comfortable with tools like Salesforce, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and able to quickly learn new technologies.
  • Resilient and proactive mindset: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and is motivated to drive urgency and outcomes.

 

It's a Plus If You Have 

  • Experience selling localisation or translation management solutions.
  • Knowledge of the SaaS market and a strong grasp of B2B sales processes.
  • Familiarity with outbound sales tools such as Outreach or Salesloft.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams.

jobs.description:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

The role

You'll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.

This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

You should have:

  • At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.

We are on a mission to give power back to investors. Great financial guidance has always existed, it just came with a minimum net worth. One simple, ambitious idea drives us: put a private banker in everyone's pocket.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1,000,000 people now trust us with their financial lives. We ship cutting-edge products with touches of delight, and we care deeply about experience, performance, and ease of use.

Why now?

A new generation of investors is emerging: ambitious, involved, done with taboos around money. We see a world where investing empowers everybody to live the life they've always dreamt of. In July 2026, the AMF granted us our MiCA license, on top of our Investment Firm license: one of the very few French platforms holding both, offering stocks, ETFs and crypto on a single regulated platform, right as Europe consolidates around licensed players. There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

The opportunity

AI is not a side project at Finary: it's how we intend to run the company. Our teams already build their own automations, so this role is about the hard part: complex orchestrations, and intelligence inside the products our advisors and operations team rely on every day. You own what you build end to end, from understanding the need with the people who'll use it to running it in production. We move fast and need an AI product engineer to move with us.



What you'll do

  • Advisory at scale: build the closing machine and the systems that accelerate our sales team

  • Allocation engines: build the recommendation engine that captures our advisors' expertise

  • Operating systems: build the agentic layer that lets our operations team orchestrate a fleet of AI agents, with minimal humans interactions

  • End-to-end ownership: gather needs with the teams who use your products, then design, build, deploy and maintain them; define what a correct agent decision looks like, measure it, and catch drift before users do

  • Enablement: help non-engineers build their own automations, step in when they need something more robust, and work with the rest of engineering on shared agentic infrastructure

What we're looking for

  • Production software experience: 3+ years shipping production grade software, including products you've owned end to end, from gathering needs to running them

  • AI systems in production: you've built and run LLM integrations, agents and multi-step orchestrations in production. You can explain how they work and evaluate them. You know when a simple rule beats an agent, and AI coding tools are part of your daily work.

  • Range across the stack: comfortable across several languages and codebases, and quick to pick up new ones. Our stack is TypeScript, Rust and Ruby, on Google Cloud and Kubernetes with infrastructure as code. You don't need to be an SRE, but you deploy and run what you build and keep data correct as systems evolve

  • Product sense and UX: you start from the problem, not the technology, and you care about the people using what you build and how it feels to use

  • High agency: you work across teams and switch context often, and you find the next problem worth solving and own it without waiting to be told

  • French and English: fluent French to work with our advisory team and the rest of the company, and professional English

  • Based in Western Europe: we expect quarterly presence for our onsite weeks in Paris

  • We're particularly interested in:

    • An agentic system you built that is in production and used today

    • How you know it works, and what it saves the people using it

    • A time you chose a simple script or rule over an agent, and why

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with fintech or a regulated industry

  • Passion for personal finance and investing

What we offer

  • Competitive salary: €65k - €80k base depending on experience, plus stock options

  • Hybrid setup: teammates across France and Europe, with one week together in Paris every quarter (travel and accommodation covered)

Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.

Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité.

 

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise).

En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre.

 

Ce que nous offrons

Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.

Découvrez nos valeurs ici.

Finary construit la banque privée de la génération internet. Notre chaîne YouTube est la première chaîne de finances personnelles en France : 880 000 abonné·es et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, entièrement produite en interne par une équipe qui traite le contenu comme un produit, c’est-à-dire mesuré, itéré, conçu avec méthode.

Tu prends en charge tout ce qui s’écrit chez Finary Media, de bout en bout : recherche, script, packaging, vérification des faits, livraison. Les mots t’appartiennent, de la première idée au montage final.

Tes deux terrains de jeu principaux :

  • La chaîne YouTube Finary. Des vidéos longues qui mêlent storytelling, économie et investissement, regardées par des centaines de milliers de personnes. Ton point de repère : nos meilleures vidéos dépassent le million de vues.

They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned.

  • Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards.

  • Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools.

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions.

  • Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized.

  • Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures.

  • Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations.

  • Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors).

  • Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups.

  • Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System.

  • Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs.

  • Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools.

  • Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines.

  • Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed.

 

Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications

  • Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent.

  • Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center.

  • In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs.

  • Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy.

  • Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team.

  • Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems.

  • Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients.

  • IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems.

  • Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus).

jobs.title: Inventory Specialist
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is

small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd

help write them from the first line, with ownership and a direct line to the founders.

Youʼll help make sure laboratory teams have the consumables they need, when they need

them. Youʼll have a say in the software they use to manage stock, and learn to use AI to make

everyday purchasing and inventory work easier.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building

once you've spoken with the team.

The role

This is a hands-on, early-career role within our Infrastructure team. Youʼll manage day-to-day

consumables purchasing, receive deliveries and keep stock records accurate, with training

and guidance from your manager and laboratory colleagues. As you learn the work, youʼll

organise your day independently and follow issues through to resolution.

Youʼll work with laboratory teams to understand demand, place orders within agreed budgets

and approvals, and chase delays before they disrupt work. Youʼll maintain supplier prices and

lead times, flag supply risks and get laboratory approval for any proposed substitutions.

At goods receipt, youʼll check orders against deliveries, including quantities, condition and

relevant batch, expiry and temperature requirements. Youʼll record receipts promptly, route

goods to the right storage and resolve discrepancies. Youʼll help physically set up storage

areas, organise stock into defined bin locations and label and barcode those locations so they

match the inventory records. Youʼll record stock movements and investigate differences

found during stock counts.

With guidance, youʼll propose reorder points and buffer stock using consumption, lead times

and planned activity. Youʼll track expiry dates, prioritise the earliest-expiring stock where

appropriate and maintain consistent item codes, units and pack conversions. Youʼll document

procedures, follow safety and quality requirements, and segregate items awaiting review.

Regular updates on supply risks and stock accuracy, together with reliable receipt records,

will help colleagues in the lab and finance.

Youʼll work directly with software engineers to shape the inventory tools you use every day.

Youʼll bring ideas from the lab, explain what needs to work differently and test new features

against real tasks. Your input will help decide what gets improved, with your manager and the

software team leading priorities, design and development. Youʼll also learn to use AI-assisted

workflows for tasks such as reviewing inventory data and preparing routine updates, then

help refine those workflows as you find better ways to work. Training and support will be part

of the role.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Learn the consumables, storage requirements and approval processes with laboratory

colleagues. Take on routine ordering and goods receipt with support.

◆ Check stock records against physical inventory and map the journey from purchase

request to use. Agree a practical storage layout and bin-location scheme with laboratory

colleagues, taking account of access and storage requirements.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run routine ordering, receipts and stock counts independently within agreed processes.

Keep colleagues informed of shortages, overdue orders and expiring stock.

◆ Physically set up and organise the agreed storage areas, label and barcode bin

locations, and link them to inventory records. Propose replenishment settings with your

manager and laboratory colleagues, and document how stock is stored and moved. Turn

recurring problems into examples for the software team.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Check that colleagues can find, receive and return stock using the labelled and

barcoded locations. Resolve gaps in the layout or records, and refine replenishment to

reduce avoidable shortages and waste.

◆ Test available inventory features against everyday tasks and help colleagues adopt

improvements. With support, try an AI-assisted workflow for a routine task, check its

outputs and suggest how to improve it.

Who you are

Youʼre proactive, organised and attentive to detail, and you enjoy practical work where

accurate records have visible consequences. When a problem arises, you flag it promptly and

investigate practical solutions while keeping colleagues informed. You act within agreed

processes, bring options when a decision needs support and follow the issue through to

resolution.

Your experience may come from inventory, purchasing, logistics or laboratory operations,

including an apprenticeship or placement. A scientific degree and coding experience are not

required. We welcome transferable experience with physical stock and time-sensitive

supplies.

Youʼre willing to help beyond a fixed task list as the team grows, while using judgement about

when to escalate. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it

and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Practical experience of inventory, purchasing, goods receipt, logistics or laboratory

operations.

◆ Careful record-keeping and an organised approach to checking deliveries, prioritising

work and following actions through.

◆ Confidence with digital tools and a willingness to learn to use AI, check its outputs and

improve recurring workflows over time. Prior AI expertise is not required.

◆ Clear communication with suppliers and colleagues, including explaining an operational

problem to a software developer.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Experience with laboratory consumables or expiry-sensitive and temperature-controlled

stock.

◆ Familiarity with inventory or ERP systems, barcode-based stock control, or testing new

software.

Why this is unusual

Alongside keeping supplies moving, youʼll help shape the software and AI-assisted workflows

that make the job easier. Youʼll work with engineers to turn a stock discrepancy or awkward

receiving step into a better tool, then see whether it works in practice. Youʼll build experience

in improving systems as well as running the day-to-day operation.

Youʼll have support as you learn, and room to contribute ideas from the start. Some people

find that mix energising; others prefer a more settled routine. It is worth knowing which suits

you.

How we work

This role is primarily on-site in Kingʼs Cross, London, typically four to five days a week,

because deliveries and physical inventory need someone there. The wider team is

distributed, so we write things down and keep colleagues informed.

We start the week with an all-hands and share written updates. We give feedback directly

and expect good ideas to be challenged on their merits, whoever proposes them.

UK benefits include 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10%

employer contribution after a three-month deferment, and Bupa private health cover.

The team you will join

Youʼll join the Infrastructure team and work closely with laboratory colleagues, software

engineers and finance. Your manager will help set priorities and support decisions on

Type: Full Time, Hybrid

Who We Are

We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era.

Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition.

Who We Are Not

  • We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings.

  • We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special.

  • We are not another “polished” SF startup. We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful.

What You’ll Own & Build

  • Model human differences. Turn motivation, goals, personality, identity, experience and technical fluency into psychologically grounded, computationally useful models that guide agents and generalise across users.

  • Infer users’ internal states. Use clickstreams, navigation paths and dwell time to model intent, confusion, patience, confidence and engagement, linking these states to each agent’s persona.

  • Shape behaviour in live interfaces. Model how traits, goals, experience and changing states such as frustration or uncertainty influence agents’ attention, choices and actions during computer use.

  • Measure human fidelity. Compare agent behaviour with human data, build benchmarks and quantify uncertainty to identify where simulations succeed or fail across user types.

  • Understand how users interpret interfaces. Study attention, expectations and mental models: what users notice first, what they overlook, and where interfaces conflict with their expectations.

  • Experiment with synthetic populations. Test how different users respond to interface and flow changes, analysing trajectories for patterns, failure modes and edge cases before launch.

Who You Are

  • You have a MSc, PhD or postdoc in Cognitive Science, Behavioral Economics, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field

  • You can reason about personality and motivation, then implement the model yourself into a prototype in a modern ML and LLM sandbox, and work with engineers to get it into production

  • You've led original research on decision-making, learning, or behavioral modeling, especially in digital contexts. Bonus for designing and running human studies.

  • Are passionate about applying your research to real-world systems without sacrificing depth or rigor.

  • Bonus

    • Experience with agent-based modeling, RL, or AI safety/alignment

    • You've worked with product teams, experimentation tools, or UX researchers

  • The Team: A deeply ambitious, unusually diverse group of researchers, engineers, founders, and operators who care about building something meaningful together.

  • The Problem: Deep science with real impact. We leverage behavioral modeling, cognitive science, and cutting-edge AI to solve real product challenges for real customers.

This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems.

  • Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls.

  • Signal & Insight Systems: Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. Turn noisy outputs into decisions.

  • Production Reliability: Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. The bar is production reliability.

jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

This is not a research role. Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

  • Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

  • You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

  • You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

  • You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

  • You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

  • You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

  • You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

  • You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

  • You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

  • You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity

  • Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000

  • MacBook Pro and full home office setup

  • 30 days annual leave

  • Private healthcare

  • Regular company off-sites and team retreats

  • International English-speaking team

  • Language lessons in English and French

  1. Screening with an ML Researcher / Engineer

  2. Home technical assignment and review with the team

  3. Culture fit interview and meet the team

  4. Reference check and offer

99 agents. One co-founder missing.

We're looking for a technical founder who gets excited about that. Someone to spot opportunities with me, challenge them, build them, and turn the strongest into businesses.

We’ll explore customer problems within our network, select two propositions, and work towards product–market fit.

Global ambition, a European base, and an eye on what we can learn from US speed, Chinese coordination, and Europe’s collective strengths.

  • You think about the customer before the stack. Who has this problem? How painful is it? Will they pay? Then: how do we solve it?

You must be based in Europe and able to work together in the Netherlands regularly. We’ll combine remote work with in-person sessions.

jobs.title: Ingénieur.e de recherche : Analyse de la chaine d'epuration de syngaz (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

 

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·       Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

·       cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

·       49 jours de congés par an

·       restauration administrative sur place

·       aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

·       action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 18 mois

  • À usage interne :

Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche

  • Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi

  • Date limite de candidature : 26/11/2026

Bochum, Germany (Ruhr University Bochum) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Quantum & Semiconductor Metrology

About ChillQuanta
ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Target market: quantum and semiconductor chip makers.

The opportunity
Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & strategy
- Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised.

Commercialization
- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.
- Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners.
Business operations
- Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have.

Requirements

What you bring

Core experience
- Business development or MBA-level commercial experience, ideally with deep-tech, scientific instrumentation, or semiconductor/quantum industry exposure.
- Comfort making a licensing-vs-startup call and building a go-to-market plan from a lab-stage prototype.

Especially valuable
- Existing network in quantum technology, semiconductor metrology, or scientific instrumentation.
- Fundraising experience for deep-tech ventures (grants and/or investors).
- ChillQuanta is separately seeking an AI/ML co-founder to build wafer-scale AI prediction — relevant ML/software experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join ChillQuanta
- A validated lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, with an Invention Disclosure already accepted by RUB and a manuscript heading to Physical Review Letters.
- A genuinely novel technique (patent filing in progress) addressing a real gap in photonic-qubit inspection for the fast-growing quantum and semiconductor chip markets.
- Ground-floor business co-founder equity alongside a strong physics/chemistry founding team.

ChillQuanta welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

jobs.title: KVGM Medewerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een centrale rol binnen KOERS waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu bovenaan staan? Dat komt dan mooi uit! Wij zijn op zoek naar een KVGM Medewerker die onze organisatie komt versterken. Solliciteer snel op deze vacature, want jij maakt voor ons het verschil!

Welke uitdagingen krijg jij als KVGM Medewerker?

Als KVGM Medewerker ondersteun je onze organisatie bij het ontwikkelen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van het beleid op gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu. Jij zorgt ervoor dat al onze collega’s hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en draagt bij aan een gezonde werkomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en het management om de kwaliteit, arbeidsomstandigheden en het milieu te optimaliseren.

Welke uitdagingen horen onder andere bij deze functie?

  • Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van werkplekinspecties en veiligheidsrondes. Je bent regelmatig te vinden op onze verschillende bouwlocaties;

  • Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden en bespreekt dit met de KVGM-coördinator;

  • Deelnemen aan en ondersteunen bij verschillende interne en externe audits;

  • Registeren en onderzoeken van incidenten, ongevallen en bijna-ongevallen;

  • Onderhouden en verbeteren van het KVGM-managementsysteem;

  • Het opstellen van een veiligheidsplan;

  • Het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving zowel op kantoor als op onze diverse bouwplaatsen;

  • Zorgdragen voor draagvlak binnen KOERS van veiligheidsbewustzijn;

  • Het uitvoeren en up to date houden van de RI&E;

  • Het verzorgen van veiligheidsinstructies, toolboxen en voorlichting;

  • Het regelen van keuringen van gereedschap en materieel.

Je standplaats is Barendrecht (Rotterdam), maar bent ook regelmatig op onze diverse projectlocaties (omgeving Randstand) te vinden. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en draagt bij aan periodieke rapportage aan onze Directeur Bouw.

Wat verwachten wij van jou als KVGM Medewerker?

Betrokkenheid, zelfstandigheid, een scherp oog voor veiligheid & kwaliteit en daarnaast plezier in je vak! Maak je werk uitdagender door op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe ideeën en werk daarin samen met je collega’s binnen KOERS. Is dit wat je zoekt? Dan hopen wij dat je over de volgende eigenschappen beschikt:

  • Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau, een opleiding in het vakgebied MVK genoten en ervaring binnen de bouwsector;

  • Kennis van de relevante wet- en regelgeving;

  • Kennis en ervaring omtrent ISO 9001, ISO 14001, VCA en SCL is een pré;

  • Je hebt oog voor risico’s en uitdagingen;

  • Je bent energiek, sociaal, ondernemend en daadkrachtig;

  • Je bent flexibel en bezit het vermogen om snel te kunnen schakelen;

  • Je staat sterk in je (werk)schoenen en hebt oog voor detail.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een verantwoordelijke functie waar je als KAM Medewerker bijdraagt aan het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving. Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week;

  • Een goed salaris dat boven de normen van de cao Bouw en Infra ligt. We gaan hier graag over in gesprek met jouw achtergrond en ervaring als uitgangspunt;

  • Een auto van de zaak met tankpas volgens onze leaseregeling;

  • Een informele werksfeer en gezellige collega’s;

  • Goed geregelde vrije dagen, 30 vakantiedagen, 10 dagen in het tijdspaarfonds en nog 3 dagen kort verzuim. In totaal dus 43 vakantiedagen. Deze zaken zijn uiteraard conform de cao Bouw en Infra;

  • Een goed ingerichte werkplek;

  • Pensioenopbouw conform de richtlijnen van de CAO Bouw en Infra, dit bouwen wij samen op;

  • Een periodieke bijdrage aan je duurzame inzetbaarheid, zodat je gezond kunt blijven werken;

  • De mogelijkheid voor het volgen van opleidingen en/of cursussen, want jouw groei/ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Wij kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons opleidingsbudget.

Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van KOERS?

Wacht dan niet langer en reageer gelijk op deze vacature!

jobs.title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
jobs.description:
Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält.

• Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft.

• Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten.

• Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung.

• Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein.

• Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben.

• Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen.

• Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen.

• Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt.

Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium

• Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0

• Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe

• Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53)

• Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

• Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Rolle wiederfinden, senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

jobs.title: Founding Principal Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us

Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope.

The role

We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security.

  • Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow.

  • Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust.

  • Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut.

  • Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows.

What you bring

  • Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth.

  • Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored.

  • Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships.

  • Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding.

  • Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you.

  • Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself.

  • Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. You work from evidence like logs, traces, metrics and query plans, and you stay calm when production breaks.

  • AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship.

  • Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Strong opinions, held with evidence and open to revision.

  • Range. You've worked across several companies, stacks or environments. How you work counts far more than how many years you've done it.

Nice to have

  • Regulated environments with audits: medical devices, health, finance.

  • Serving ML models in production.

What we offer

  • Ownership from day one. As a founding engineer, you're part of the company through our virtual share option plan (VSOP).

  • You grow with us. As the company grows, your role grows with it.

  • Real influence. You decide how we build software, and you shape the engineering team we build.

  • A competitive salary.

  • A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff.

  • Flexible hours and office days. We work from Berlin and meet in person regularly, up to several days a week. This isn't a fully remote role.

  • English is our working language. German isn't required.

  • We sponsor the EU Blue Card if you're moving to Berlin.

  • Nutzung eines eigens entwickelten Blender-Addons zur Vergabe der Labels.

  • Dokumentation der gelabelten Daten und Prüfung auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit.

  • Rückmeldung zu Funktionalität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit des Addons, ggf. Mitwirken bei der Optimierung des Workflows.

2D-Raumpläne nachzeichnen:

  • Übertragung von digitalen oder Papier-Raumplänen in Blender als 2D-Layouts unter Verwendung einfacher Formen wie Linien oder extrudierten Polygonen.

  • Überprüfung der Nachzeichnungen auf Genauigkeit und Konsistenz mit den Vorlagen.

  • Eigenständiges Erkennen und Nachfragen bei fehlenden Informationen oder Unklarheiten in den Plänen.

jobs.description:
Clariness is looking for a Senior Business Development Director (f/md/) based in Germany, UK, Serbia, South Africa.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

Clariness helps patients access clinical trials faster through our ClinLife® platform, active in 50+ countries. In this role, you will turn expertise into real-world impact, connecting patients with studies and accelerating medical breakthroughs. Make your next role matter - help more patients join life-changing studies.


As a Senior Business Development Director, you would be responsible for:

  • Prospecting, developing, and closing new business opportunities within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, and CRO sectors.

  • Growing and managing strategic and existing customer accounts.

  • Building strong relationships with clients, partners, distributors, and key opinion leaders.

  • Representing the company at conferences, networking events, and client meetings.

  • Maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and providing reliable sales forecasts.

  • Supporting leadership in achieving commercial objectives and identifying opportunities to improve products, services, and processes.

  • Acting as a trusted advisor by bringing market insights and challenging existing approaches to drive continuous improvement.

We would like you to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Minimum 8 years of sales and business development experience with responsibility for achieving commercial targets.

  • Proven experience working with large pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology, CROs, or the broader life sciences industry.

  • Experience across key commercial and marketing disciplines, including communications, demand generation, and product marketing, in international markets.

  • Experience supporting or leading large-scale patient recruitment campaigns.

  • Demonstrated success in building strategic client relationships and driving business growth.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing high-performing commercial or marketing talent is an advantage.

  • Self-driven, strategic, and customer-focused with the ability to build lasting partnerships.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.

  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.

  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.

  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.

  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.

  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.

  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect:

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).

  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview → Demo Day → Decision.

  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step.

jobs.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) - Praktikum Marketing & Präsentationsgestaltung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Karriereservice,de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Wir begleiten Menschen auf ihrem beruflichen Weg – ob beim Karriereeinstieg, in der Neuorientierung oder beim nächsten Karriereschritt. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen, Hochschulen und Privatpersonen.

Zur kreativen Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir Dich – in unserem Büro Kaarst, hybrid oder vollständig remote. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Erstellung und Gestaltung ansprechender Präsentationen. Darüber hinaus wirkst Du an Blogartikeln sowie weiteren Marketing- und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen mit und bringst eigene Ideen für unseren Außenauftritt ein.

Start & Dauer: Idealerweise startest Du im November oder Dezember und unterstützt uns für etwa drei Monate. Den genauen Zeitraum stimmen wir gerne gemeinsam mit Dir ab.

Aufgaben

Freue Dich auf die Arbeit in einem modernen und offenen Beratungsunternehmen. Bei uns bist Du von Anfang an mittendrin statt nur dabei und gestaltest aktiv mit. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Raum für eigene Ideen und Einblicke in unseren Beratungsalltag:

  • Du gestaltest Präsentationen und Schulungsunterlagen rund um Karriere, Bewerbung, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und Führung und bringst Inhalte verständlich und visuell ansprechend auf den Punkt.

  • Du wirkst an Blogartikeln und weiteren Texten mit: Du recherchierst spannende Themen, entwickelst Ideen und unterstützt uns beim Schreiben und Überarbeiten.

  • Du unterstützt unseren digitalen Auftritt mit Beiträgen, Grafiken und kreativen Konzepten für unsere Webseite und Social-Media-Kanäle wie LinkedIn und Instagram.

  • Du gestaltest weitere Marketingmaterialien mit, wie beispielsweise die Vorstellung unserer Beratungs- und Trainingsangebote.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Beraterteam und anderen Werkstudierenden zusammen, tauschst Ideen aus und setzt gemeinsame Projekte um.

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in unser Unternehmen und unsere Arbeitsweise: Du lernst unterschiedliche Beratungs- und Trainingsangebote kennen und erfährst, wie wir Menschen bei ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung begleiten.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für kleinere Projekte, passend zu Deinen Interessen und Stärken.

Qualifikation

Du studierst beispielsweise BWL mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign oder ein vergleichbares Fach. Entscheidend sind für uns Dein Interesse an Marketing und Kommunikation sowie Deine Freude daran, Inhalte und Ideen ansprechend aufzubereiten.

Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Gestaltung und Freude daran, Präsentationen, Grafiken und andere Materialien übersichtlich und ansprechend zu gestalten.

  • Du formulierst klar und verständlich und hast Spaß daran, Texte zu entwickeln, zu überarbeiten und auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen abzustimmen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für Karriere, Arbeitswelt und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Themen ein.

  • Du bist digital affin: Erste Erfahrungen mit PowerPoint, Canva oder vergleichbaren Gestaltungsprogrammen sind willkommen. Kenntnisse in Social Media oder der Webseitenpflege sind ein zusätzliches Plus.

  • Du bist neugierig auf die Möglichkeiten von KI und möchtest sie für Recherche, Texte und Gestaltung sinnvoll einsetzen. Erste Erfahrungen sind willkommen. Vieles kannst Du auch bei uns lernen.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und zunehmend eigenständig, achtest auf Details und fragst nach, wenn Du Unterstützung brauchst.

  • Du hast Lust auf Zusammenarbeit, tauschst Dich gerne mit unserem Beraterteam und anderen Werkstudierenden aus und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass Du Lust hast, Neues auszuprobieren, dazuzulernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas umzusetzen.

Benefits

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen!

  • Mitgestalten von Anfang an: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und Projekte und erhältst dabei Unterstützung aus dem Team.

  • Abwechslung & Einblicke: Du probierst Dich aus und lernst unseren Beratungs- und Trainingsalltag kennen.

  • Kreativer Freiraum: Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Du kannst neue Formate entwickeln und Deine Stärken einbringen.

  • Flexibilität & Vertrauen: Arbeite in unserem Büro in Kaarst, hybrid oder vollständig remote – mit flexiblen Zeiten, die zu Deiner Lebenssituation passen.

  • Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Dich erwartet ein offenes Team mit persönlichem Austausch, Humor und gegenseitiger Unterstützung.

  • Lernen & Weiterentwicklung: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung, erhältst konstruktives Feedback und erweiterst Deine Kenntnisse in Gestaltung, Kommunikation und KI.

Neugierig? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!
