Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Messgeräten gestalten unsere rund 18000 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft im Bereich der Prozessautomatisierung. Ob bei der Innovation und Umsetzung neuer Technologien im Team, der Zusammenarbeit in der Entwicklung neuer Geräte oder der Stärkung wichtiger Beziehungen zu verschiedenen globalen Industrien: Unsere Arbeit basiert darauf, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen, die allen zum Erfolg verhelfen. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen schauen wir über kurzfristige Ziele hinaus und arbeiten daran, eine zukunftsorientierte Vision für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Welt im Allgemeinen zu schaffen. Wir suchen eine\*n HR Expert\*in Talent Acquisition (w/m/d) für Endress\+ Flow, der\*die unser Team verstärkt und durch die Gewinnung passender Talente aktiv zum Erfolg unserer Organisation beiträgt.  **Worum geht es in dieser Stelle?**In dieser identifizieren und gewinnen Sie Menschen, die mit ihrer Expertise, ihrem Wissen und ihrer Persönlichkeit die Zukunft unserer Technologien und unserer Arbeit prägen. Unsere Messlösungen helfen Unternehmen weltweit, Ressourcen zu schonen, Energie effizienter zu nutzen und Prozesse nachhaltiger zu gestalten. Damit wir diese Wirkung erzielen können, brauchen wir die richtigen Talente.Sie tragen entscheidend dazu bei, diesen Weg erfolgreich weiterzugehen. Wir legen besonderen Wert darauf, dass Sie nicht nur fachlich überzeugen, sondern auch Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in unserem Team mitbringen.  HR Expert\*in Talent Acquisition (w/m/d)======================================== **Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?**Sie werden:* End\-to\-end\-Rekrutierungsprozesse für unsere unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereiche leiten \- wo notwendig unterstützt durch Active Sourcing oder zielgerichtete Direktansprachen.* Hiring\-Manager und HR Business Partner beraten, um fundierte und faire Auswahlprozesse sicherzustellen.* Interviews moderieren, Feedbackstrukturen leiten und transparente Entscheidungsprozesse begleiten.* Markt\- und Trendanalysen nutzen, um unsere Talent Acquisition Strategie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.* mit globalen TA\-Teams und Employer Branding zusammenarbeiten, um eine starke Candidate Experience sicherzustellen.   **Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?**Sie:* verfügen über einen Bachelor\- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-) Psychologie oder Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Weiterbildung.* bringen Erfahrung im Recruiting von technischen Profilen mit.* verstehen den Arbeitsmarkt im technischen und kaufmännischen Umfeld und interessieren sich für Trends und Entwicklungen.* kommunizieren klar, wertschätzend und überzeugend und arbeiten gerne eng mit Führungskräften zusammen.* haben Erfahrung im Active Sourcing und im Umgang mit Tools wie LinkedIn Recruiter und idealerweise SuccessFactors.* treten vertrauenswürdig auf, bauen schnell Beziehungen auf und begleiten Kandidaturen professionell durch den Prozess.* arbeiten lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und bringen Initiative mit.* sprechen und schreiben fliessend Deutsch und Englisch.   **Was können Sie von uns erwarten?*** Wir sind ein familiengeführtes, hoch engagiertes Unternehmen mit einer nachhaltigen Vision.* Wir fördern lebenslanges Lernen mit vielseitigen Schulungs\- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, internem Wissenstransfer und E\-Learning.* Wir fördern Work\-Life\-Balance und bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeiten für Remote\-Arbeit (25%), um unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Aufrechterhaltung eines gesunden Gleichgewichts zu unterstützen.* Wir bieten Unterstützung bei nachhaltigen Mobilitätslösungen wie öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, um unseren Mitarbeitenden ein einfaches Pendeln zu ermöglichen.  ![Endress+ ]()*** ![Endress+ ]()***jid43c9db7jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

B. TOGAF)* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als ICT\-, Lösungs\- oder Enterprise\-Architekt/\-in, vorzugsweise mit Erfahrung in öffentlichen Organisationen oder IT\-Service\-Providern* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Enterprise Architecture sowie in der Gestaltung und Dokumentation von Daten\-, Applikations\-, Technologie\-, Security\- und Netzwerkarchitekturen* Erfahrung mit Architektur\-Governance, Technologieportfolios und Roadmaps sowie mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum und SAFe* Ausgeprägte analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, gepaart mit Problemlösungskompetenz, Beratungs\- und Verhandlungsgeschick sowie einer selbstständigen und kundenorientierten Arbeitsweise; Erfahrung mit modernen Technologien wie Microservices, Container\-Management und DevOps von Vorteil* Gute aktive Kenntnisse zweier Amtssprachen  **Auf den Punkt gebracht**Du bist ICT\-Architekt/\-in aus Leidenschaft? Bei uns entwickeln neugierige Köpfe, ambitionierte Macher/\-innen und innovative Vorausdenker/\-innen vielfältige digitalen Lösungen für die Schweiz. Wir unterstützen und fördern mobiles sowie ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten. So können unsere Teamplayer/\-innen ihre Arbeit wo möglich flexibel und individuell gestalten \- für die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf. jobs.description: Bist Du motiviert, namhafte Kunden bei der digitalen Transformation zu unterstützen? Oder liebst Du es, bedürfnisorientierte IT Lösungen für individuelle Anforderungen auszugestalten? Ist es Deine Berufung, dem Kunden nicht nur die für ihn beste Lösung auszuarbeiten, sondern auch gleich noch das passende Wartungspaket für den anschliessenden Betrieb und Unterhalt zu schnüren? Unser Angebot umfasst Cloud Lösungen und schlüsselfertige ICT\\-Infrastrukturen -- genaustens abgestimmt auf die Kundenbedürfnisse. Mit 25 Mitarbeiter:innen sorgen wir an unseren drei Firmen\\-Standorten in Luzern, Nidwalden und Obwalden dafür, dass unsere überregionalen Kunden den nächsten Schritt innerhalb der digitalen Transformation gehen. Unser Team besteht aus beeindruckenden High\\-Performern, die für die Werte Innovationskraft, Qualität und Herzlichkeit brennen. Wir sind stets auf der Suche nach neuen innovativen Köpfen. Gemeinsam kreieren wir zukunftsorientierte Lösungen, um für unsere Kunden das bestmögliche Arbeitsumfeld zu erschaffen. jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Assistenz Abteilungsleitung (m/w/d)--- Assistenz Abteilungsleitung (m/w/d)===================================Assistenz Abteilungsleitung (m/w/d)===================================Die ETH Zürich orientiert sich in Lehre, Forschung und Verwaltung an höchsten internationalen Standards. Die Abteilung Campus Services unterstützt Lehre, Forschung und Verwaltung in den Bereichen Logistik, Mobilität und Veranstaltungen. Sie stellt zudem ein umfassendes Informationsmanagement sowie die Orientierung an der ETH Zürich sicher und verantwortet das Gastronomie\- und Detailhandelsangebot.Für unsere Abteilungsleitung suchen wir per **1\. Dezember 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung** eine erfahrene, selbstständige und vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit, die unsere Leiterin Campus Services sowie das Leitungsteam im anspruchsvollen Tagesgeschäft unterstützt. In dieser Schlüsselrolle hältst du viele Fäden zusammen, erkennst Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig und schaffst dort Mehrwert, wo Unterstützung gebraucht wird. Dabei denkst du nicht nur mit, sondern voraus.Stellenbeschreibung-------------------Du unterstützt die Leiterin Campus Services sowie das Leitungsteam in administrativen, organisatorischen und koordinativen Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse effizient und reibungslos funktionieren. Dabei koordinierst und organisierst du Termine, Workshops, Sitzungen und Veranstaltungen, bereitest Unterlagen auf und behältst auch bei parallel laufenden Themen den Überblick.Als zentrale Ansprechperson bewegst du dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und sensiblen Themen. Du erhältst Einblick in strategische, personelle und organisatorische Fragestellungen und trägst mit deiner Diskretion, deinem Urteilsvermögen und deiner hohen Professionalität massgeblich zum Erfolg des Führungsteams bei.Neben der klassischen Management\-Assistenz agierst du als proaktive Drehscheibe innerhalb der Abteilung. Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Arbeitsweisen. Die Organisation und Nachbereitung von Events, die Unterstützung bei Personalprozessen vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt sowie die Begleitung neuer Mitarbeitender während des Onboardings gehören ebenso zu deinem Aufgabenbereich wie die Koordination von IT\-Bestellungen und Arbeitsplatzvorbereitungen.Darüber hinaus gestaltest du die interne Kommunikation aktiv mit, pflegst und entwickelst digitale Informationsplattformen weiter und stellst sicher, dass Informationen zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet und zugänglich sind. Du übernimmst Koordinationsaufgaben in Projekten und bringst deine Affinität für Digitalisierung und moderne Technologien gezielt ein.Profil------* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen Assistenz\-, Koordinations\- oder Administrationsfunktion, idealerweise im Umfeld von Führungsgremien oder Managementteams* Hohe Selbstständigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten eigenverantwortlich zu setzen und auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick zu behalten* Ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick, vernetztes Denken und ein Blick über den Tellerrand* Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigeninitiative und ausgeprägtem Dienstleistungsverständnis* Souveräner und absolut diskreter Umgang mit vertraulichen, sensiblen und personenbezogenen Informationen* Hohe digitale Affinität sowie Interesse an neuen Technologien, Digitalisierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz* Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Microsoft 365, SharePoint und modernen digitalen Arbeitswerkzeugen* Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift* Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichsten Anspruchsgruppen* Strukturierte, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein* Reife Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Urteilsvermögen und ProfessionalitätWer Verantwortung übernimmt, mitdenkt und Veränderungen aktiv mitgestalten möchte, findet hier ein Umfeld, in dem Ideen willkommen sind und Eigeninitiative geschätzt wird. **gesagt:** Du bist weit mehr als eine administrative Unterstützung. Du bist Sparringspartner:in, organisatorische Drehscheibe und eine vertrauensvolle Stütze für die Abteilungsleitung und das gesamte Leitungsteam.Wir bieten----------Dein Beruf mit Wirkung: Werde Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt.Arbeiten im Vizepräsidium für Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) bedeutet, die Zukunft der ETH Zürich aktiv mitzugestalten – eine inspirierende, internationale und innovative Institution. Dein Engagement schafft beste Voraussetzungen für Exzellenz in Lehre, Forschung, Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit der ETH Zürich.In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir bieten nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns erwartet dich eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem innovativen und wertschätzenden Umfeld, das du mitgestalten kannst und dir neue Perspektiven eröffnet.* Flexible, gemeinsam gestaltbare Arbeitsmodelle und Möglichkeit für Homeoffice* wie z.B. ÖV\-Abonnemente, breites Sportangebot des , Kinderbetreuung oder* Wir lebenDiversität und Nachhaltigkeit sind uns wichtig-----------------------------------------------Im Einklang mit unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und pflegen ein Arbeits\- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller Mitarbeitenden und Studierenden respektiert werden. Auf unserer erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent an einerNeugierig? Sind wir auch.-------------------------Wir freuen uns auf deine Online\-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:* Motivationsschreiben* CV* Arbeitszeugnisse \& DiplomeBitte bewerbe dich ausschliesslich über das Online\-Bewerbungsportal. Bewerbungen per E\-Mail sowie auf dem Postweg werden nicht berücksichtigt.Weitere Informationen findest du auf den Webseiten der und der .Für Auskünfte steht dir , E\-Mail: (keine Bewerbungsunterlagen), gerne zur Verfügung.Gerne weisen wir darauf hin, dass die Vorselektion durch die verantwortlichen Rekrutierenden und nicht durch künstliche Intelligenz durchgeführt wird.Für Personalvermittlungen gelten die .Über die ETH Zürich---------------------Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch\-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt. Wir sind bekannt für unsere exzellente Lehre, wegweisende Grundlagenforschung und den direkten Transfer von neuen Erkenntnissen in die Gesellschaft. Über 30'000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden bei uns ein Umfeld, das eigenständiges Denken fördert, und ein Klima, das zu Spitzenleistungen inspiriert. Im Herzen Europas und weltweit vernetzt entwickeln wir gemeinsam Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid7eb6ef5jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: AI Engineer

Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's of het ontwikkelen van nieuwe diensten is een mooie pré.

Herken je jezelf in het grootste deel van dit profiel, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt terecht in een professionele en informele werkomgeving waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en samenwerking. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten aan uitdagende klantcases en krijgt de mogelijkheid om impact te maken op zowel klantresultaten als de ontwikkeling van het team.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.900 en € 5.500 op basis van 40 uur.

  • Een fulltime functie met veel zelfstandigheid en strategische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 12 maanden, met uitzicht op een vast contract.

  • Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget en aanvullende ontwikkelmogelijkheden op teamniveau.

  • Toegang tot professionele marketingtools, kennisplatforms en vakgerichte trainingen.

  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkeltraject waarin je zelf mede richting geeft aan jouw groei.

  • De mogelijkheid om tijdens een jaarlijkse workation vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Een laptop en de benodigde faciliteiten om je werk goed uit te voeren.

  • Een verzorgde lunch op kantoor en mogelijkheden om samen met collega's te sporten.

  • Gezellige teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrels en een informele werksfeer.

  • Aandacht voor vitaliteit, welzijn en een gezonde werk-privébalans.

Klaar voor jouw volgende stap?

Wil jij jouw Paid Media-expertise inzetten op strategisch niveau, werken met uitdagende klanten en tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van een ambitieus marketingteam? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! We vertellen je graag meer over de organisatie, de klanten en de mogelijkheden binnen deze functie.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
jobs.description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.

In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.

Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will

  • Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

  • Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

  • Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

  • Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

  • Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

  • Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team


  • Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

  • Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

  • Fluent in English and Dutch

  • Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

  • Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

  • Onboarding: Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

  • Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

  • Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.

  • Invest in your future: A solid pension plan.

  • Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

  • Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

  • Your Development: We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

  • Vitality: Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

  • Together at CM.com: Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

jobs.title: Salivastaava / The Barö
jobs.description: **Intohimona laatu, luonto ja elämykset? Etsimme ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa The Barö -hotelliin!**Etsimme Inkoon upeaan saaristomaisemaan The Barö -hotelliin energistä, itsenäistä ja sydämellään työtä tekevää ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa.Jos sinulla on aito intohimo laadukasta ruokaa, juomaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan ja haluat olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä uniikissa premium-ympäristössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!**Työnkuvasi:**- **Käytännön työnjohto ja sali:** Toimit salitiimin esihenkilönä, minkä lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti suorittavaan työhön ja toimit itse myös À la carte -tarjoilijana. Varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että asiakaspalvelumme laatu on aina ensiluokkaista. - **Juomatuotteen kehittäminen:** Suunnittelet hotellin uniikin cocktail-listan, trendikkäät ja laadukkaat mocktailit sekä vastaat muista juomatuotteista. - **Sommelierin rooli:** Vastaat ravintolamme laadukkaista viineistä, toimit viiniasiantuntijana ja suosittelet asiakkaillemme täydellisiä makupareja. _Etkö ole vielä valmis sommelier? Ei hätää – me The Barössä olemme valmiita kouluttamaan sinut tähän rooliin, jos asenteesi on kohdallaan!_ **Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Aitoa, palavaa intohimoa ja kiinnostusta ruoka- ja juomakulttuuria sekä korkeatasoista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan. - Sujuvuutta ja varmuutta À la carte -tarjoilussa sekä halua toimia tiimin veturina vauhdikkaissakin tilanteissa. - **Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta:** Hotellimme sijaitsee upealla paikalla luonnon keskellä, jonne ei pääse julkisilla kulkuvälineillä. Tehtävän hoitaminen ja työmatkat edellyttävät siksi omaa autoa. - Arvostamme oikeaa asennetta, oppimishalua ja käytännön kokemusta. **Ravintolamme arki ja rytmi:**Työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat viikonpäivien mukaan:- **Viikonloppuisin** tarjoilemme korkeatasoista À la carte -illallista sekä lauantaisin maistuvaa lounasta. - **Arkisin** hotellimme täyttyy yrityskokouksista, yksityistilaisuuksista ja muista tapahtumista, jotka tuovat vaihtelua työviikkoon. **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Työsuhde ja tunnit:** Kyseessä on vakituinen työsuhde. Tarjolla on täydet tunnit, noin 160 h / kk. - **Palkkaus:** Tuntipalkka MaRa TES mukaisesti. Voit esittää palkkatoiveesi. Alkuvuodesta mahdollisuus siirtyä kuukausipalkkaiseksi suoraan The Barön kirjoille, jolloin kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sovitaan erikseen. - Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi (esim. sommelier-koulutus) ja vaikuttaa suoraan ravintolamme juoma- ja palvelutuotteeseen. - Upean ja inspiroivan työympäristön sekä lämminhenkisen tiimin tuen. Vuonna 2021 avattu **The Barö** on ekologisesti rakennettu, korkealuokkainen premium-tason boutique-saaristohotelli. Se sijaitsee Inkoon upeassa Barösundissa, vain reilun tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingistä. Hotellikokonaisuus on suunniteltu sulautumaan harmonisesti ympäröivään luontoon sitä kunnioittaen, ja se koostuu uniikeista, erillisistä maisemahuoneista, tyylikkäästä rantasaunasta sekä korkeatasoisesta **The Berg -ravintolasta**. Asiakkaille tarjotaan ensiluokkaisia ruoka- ja juomaelämyksiä, yksilöllistä palvelua sekä rauhoittumista saaristoluonnon syleilyssä ympäri vuoden.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. Tavoitteena on muuttaa henkilöstöpalvelutoimialaa inhimillisemmäksi ja innostavammaksi. Arvojamme ovat joustavuus, ammattitaito, kumppanuus ja turvallisuus. Välitämme ihmisiä, joista välitämme.**Heräsikö kysymyksiä?**Laita meille sähköpostia **rekry@jobtodo.fi**, vastaamme kaikkiin kysymyksiisi. Pidäthän varmuuden vuoksi silmällä myös roskapostikansiotasi.Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description: **Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!****Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.****Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.**Mitä edellytämme:**- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla. - Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti. - Motivaatio oppia palvelut ja tuotteet sekä kyky toimia tavoitteellisesti ja vastuullisesti. - Tavoitteellisuutta ja innokkuutta suoramyyntiä kohtaan. - Kyky toimia itsenäisesti, suunnitella ja toteuttaa työtehtäviä ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen jälkeen. - Kokemusta asiakastyötä tai itsenäistä tekemistä sisältävistä rooleista. - Käytännön valmiudet ottaa asiakaskohtaamiset ja päätöksenteko hallintaan kenttätyössä. - Turvasuojaajakortin edellyttämä nuhteettomuus rikosrekisterissä. Neuvomme kortin hankinnassa aina työsuhteen alkaessa. **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Kannustavan palkkamallin, maksamme noin 300€/kauppa provisioista. Keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat noin **3000-5000€ / kk**, ja parhaiten tienaavat yltävät **10 000€ / kk tai sen yli.** - **Takuupalkan 2000€/kk** työsuhteen kolmena ensimmäisenä kuukautena, joka koostuu 500€ pohjapalkasta ja 1500€/kk takuuprovisiosta. Tuemme alkuvaiheen onnistumistasi maksamalla korotettuja provisioita työn ensimmäisten kuukausin aikana. - Käyttöetuauton, jolla pääset liikkumaan sekä työ- että vapaa-ajalla. - Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen koko työsuhteesi aikana. Aloitat työsi neljän päivän koulutuskurssilla toimistolla, jonka jälkeen perehdytys jatkuu kentällä yhdessä kouluttajien sekä esihenkilösi kanssa. Katso Youtube kanavaltamme (Verisure Suomi) videoltakouluttajamme Peterin esittely siitä, miten koulutamme sinut tehtävään. - Miellyttävän ja välittävän työyhteisön. Olemme myös tutkitusti hyvä työnantaja. Meille on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Lisäksi sijoituimme Suomen parhaat työpaikat -gaalassa keskisuurten yritysten kategoriassa. - Yhteistä tekemistä ja paljon erilaisia tapahtumia. Pääset esimerkiksi tutustumaan sekä näkemään eri kaupungeissa työskenteleviä myyjiä koko firman myyntitapahtumien yhteydessä, tai nauttimaan koko organisaatiolle järjestettävässä Inspiration Day –kesätapahtumassa. - Myyntikilpailuja, joista voit voittaa mm. Ulkomaanmatkoja. Katso tästäInstagram tililtämme video myyjiemme palkintomatkasta Saksaan. - Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi – tällä hetkellä lähes jokainen kenttämyynnin esihenkilö on edennyt tehtäväänsä talon sisältä. Katso tarinoita urasivuiltamme sekä sosiaalisen median tileiltämme. - Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten käyttöetuauto, kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä, hammaslääkärietu, lounasetu, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut. Pääset tutustumaan meihin sekä Verisuren myyntityöhön tarkemmin sosiaalisen median tiliemme kautta TikTokissa ja Instagramissa @verisurelaiset.**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Verisuren myyjänä seisot ylpeästi tuotteesi takana ja turvaat samalla ihmisten kodit sekä yritystilat suomen suosituimmalla sekä luotetuimmalla kodinturva-alan palvelulla. Lähetä hakemus tehtävään sivulla olevasta linkistä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuaikana, ja paikat täytetään aina sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi.

jobs.title: Technical Plant Support Technician
jobs.description:
Als Technical Plant Support Technician (TPS) ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt bij storingen van utilities installaties. (Elektriciteit, cooling & heating, HVAC).

  • Je neemt het alarm aan op het alert-systeem en doet de eerstelijnsinterventie. Bij uitvallen van de installatie neem je acties om de installatie binnen de kortst mogelijke tijdspanne terug operationeel te krijgen.
  • Je werkt hierbij steeds volgens de geldende Pfizer veiligheidsprocedures en algemene GMP.
  • Correct rapporteren van voorvallen in een gevalideerd systeem behoort ook tot de taak en is belangrijk voor verdere impactbepaling door QA.
  • Je werkt zeer kwaliteitsgericht en volgt afspraken na, ook al sta je onder tijdsdruk.
  • Je escaleert (wederkerende) storingen en doet samen met de zone-ingenieurs onderzoek naar grondoorzaken, waarbij je ook voorstellen doet ter verbetering.
  • Preventieve- en curatieve onderhoudstaken behoren eveneens tot je takenpakket.
  • Daarnaast doe je ook periodieke checks op installaties volgens voorgeschreven controlelijsten. (nooddiesels, sprinklerinstallaties, stoomketels, waterinstallaties, …)
  • Je hecht veel belang aan veilig werken. Je meldt onveilige situaties aan supervisie en spreekt collega´s aan op onveilige handelingen of onveilig gedrag.
  • Je zal werken in een vijfploegensysteem.
  • Bachelor diploma in elektromechanica, Elektriciteit, HVAC of gelijkwaardig door relevante ervaring
  • Zeer brede technische kennis: Hoogspanning, sterkstroom, mechanisch, pneumatisch, meet- en regeltechniek, automatisatie
  • Zin om complexe problemen te analyseren
  • Prioriteiten inschatten op basis van algemene richtlijnen
  • Autonoom aan de slag gaan
  • Vlotte en duidelijke communicatie naar collega's en interne klanten
  • Objectief rapporteren op basis van feiten en meetcijfers
  • Kwaliteitsgericht werken

jobs.title: Service engineer Postpress
jobs.description:
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Installeren, configureren en in bedrijf stellen van Heidelberg afwerkingsapparatuur
  • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, inspecties, upgrades en retrofits.
  • Analyseren en oplossen van mechanische en elektrische storingen, zowel remote als ter plaatse.
  • Opleiden en begeleiden van operatoren en technische medewerkers bij klanten.
  • Opstellen van servicerapporten en technische documentatie.
  • Samenwerken met internationale technische support-, R&D- en productspecialistenteams.
  • Actief bijdragen aan klanttevredenheid en een optimale servicebeleving.

Jouw profiel

  • Je beschikt over een technische opleiding in elektromechanica, elektronica, automatisering, grafische technologie of een vergelijkbare richting, en beschikt over een rijbewijs B.
  • Ervaring met afwerkingsapparatuur in de grafische sector of industriële productieomgevingen is een sterke troef.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van mechanica en/of elektronica.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, analytisch en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je bent bereid regelmatig te reizen binnen Benelux en incidenteel naar het buitenland voor opleidingen en ondersteuning.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Frans. Kennis van Engels of Duits is een belangrijke meerwaarde.

jobs.title: Safeguarding Lead - Safeguarding Unit (f/x/m) - Brussels
jobs.description:
Global Safeguarding Strategy and Culture

  • Enhance and oversee the delivery of the OCB Safeguarding Strategy ensuring it is enhanced, developed, and maintained and monitored, and is a mainstreamed issue within OCB

  • Provide strategic vision to drive through essential, systematic integration of SG into all of OCB's work

  • Act as strategic lead for all constituents of safeguarding in OCB operations, with specific emphasis on preventative aspects of work

  • Build a culture that embodies a consistent tone, energy and language on Safeguarding

  • In close collaboration with OCB departments and Executive Leadership Team, drive the integration of safeguarding roles and responsibilities throughout all aspects of OCB's work

OCB Safeguarding Systems, Policies and Systems

  • Ensure that standards of safeguarding are maintained across all parts of OCB

  • Ensure a robust and effective case management process & work to enhance the case management system

  • Ensure the development of staff capacity through the promotion and embedding of safeguarding policies and procedures across the movement

  • Oversee the Case Management and Reporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs)

  • Enhance and maintain OCB Safeguarding standards and Operating Procedures to take into consideration learning through implementation and necessary changes

Thought Leadership and Influencing

  • Participate in stakeholder engagement including participation in international sector platforms on safeguarding, benchmarking market best practice and positioning OCB as a thought subject -matter leader

  • Strengthen the SG voice within program design, risk assessment and mitigation and safe programming in a coordinated and consistent way

  • Ensure the integration of safe programming and safeguarding risk management throughout the project cycle, including safe and accessible community-based reporting mechanisms for SEAH and adequate safeguarding response capacity at country level, in close collaboration with the Operational Department

  • Lead the coordination of safeguarding positioning and external engagement within the wider sector and represent OCB externally on sector wide debates on safeguarding management

Leadership of Safeguarding resources

  • Engage with the members of the IPOB and Safeguarding network of colleagues across the movement

  • Lead, support, and develop the OCB Safeguarding Team

  • Management and leadership of the safeguarding team

  • Ownership and management of the Safeguarding Unit budget

  • Work with the HR Director to ensure compliance with safeguarding policies, including safe recruitment practices

  • Monitor activity to ensure there is an adequate resource for the Safeguarding Unit

Education & Experience

  • Relevant qualification in safeguarding, law, ethics, social work, gender-based violence or a related field, and/or at least five (5) years' experience preventing, detecting and responding to sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment and other forms of misconduct

jobs.title: Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
The mission
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity
As our new Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js.

Your average week in Utrecht:

  • Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

  • Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

  • Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

  • Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

  • Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

  • Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

  • Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

  • Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

  • Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

  • Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth

  • Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

  • An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach


The musts

  • You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

  • Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

  • At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

  • Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

  • Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

  • You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English

  • You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback


The nice-to-haves

  • Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech

The benefits

  • A salary between €4,000 and €5,500 gross per month (based on 40 hours, depending on experience), with room to grow

  • 25 vacation days (based on full-time)

  • A pension plan (10%, of which we pay 50%)

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year (based on full-time)

  • A MacBook Pro and everything you need to do your job well

  • Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan

  • A hybrid setup: at least 3 days at the office, flexible beyond that

  • The option to work remotely from abroad for up to 6 weeks per year

  • Daily healthy lunches, Friday drinks and monthly team activities 🎉

  • An ambitious, international environment where we challenge each other and celebrate wins together

Sounds good? 🙌 We’d love to hear from you. Who knows, we might be meeting each other soon.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider

Deze aannemer met de vacature van rioolarbeider te Aalst is actief in de wegenbouw, rioleringsaanleg, milieusanering en de aanleg van publieke ruimtes. Hun projecten zijn voor zowel publieke als private opdrachtgevers in Vlaanderen en Brussel. Het bedrijf behoort tot de top 3 spelers op de Belgische infrastructuurmarkt. Vanuit verschillende vestigingen beschikken ze over eigen betonsites, recyclagesites en asfaltproductie-installaties. De bedrijfscultuur is open en samenwerkend: collega’s ondersteunen elkaar om veilig en kwalitatief werk te leveren. Kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid staan centraal, met aandacht voor planning, correcte uitvoering en ruimte om te leren en te groeien.

Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider in de regio Aalst werk je samen met je ploeg op verschillende werven en voer je het onderstaande takenpakket uit:

  • Je vertrekt met je team vanaf een afgesproken opstapplaats in de regio Aalst naar de werf en stemt ter plaatse de dagplanning af met de ploegbaas en werfleiding.
  • Je voert rioleringswerken uit, zoals het maken van huisaansluitingen, het plaatsen van rioleringsbuizen en putten, en het ophogen of vrijmaken van putdeksels.
  • Je plaatst en werkt weginfrastructuur af, waaronder funderingen, kolken, boordstenen, goten en straat- of klinkerwerken.
  • Je gebruikt klein bouwmaterieel en gereedschap voor grond- en wegenwerken, zoals trilplaten, slijpschijven en (kleine) graafmachines.
  • Je houdt de werf ordelijk en veilig, controleert hoogtes en uitzettingen waar nodig, en helpt mee om de uitvoering volgens planning te laten verlopen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder vind je wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job in de regio Aalst:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt in de regio Aalst.
  • Je hebt al (een eerste) ervaring als grondwerker, arbeider in rioleringswerken of wegenwerker.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om te starten als rioolarbeider en je wil fysiek werken in weer en wind.
  • Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs B of bent er concreet mee aan de slag (praktijklessen en/of praktijkexamen ingepland).
  • Je hecht belang aan veilig en vlot communiceren op de werf.
  • Je kan vroeg starten en je bent flexibel naar werkuren, overuren en werven op verschillende locaties.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag werkt in teamverband, vlot afstemt met ploegbaas en collega’s en meehelpt waar nodig om samen vooruitgang te maken.
  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.
  • Iemand die houdt van buitenwerk en fysiek werk, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden: je blijft doorzetten tot het werk klaar is.
  • Iemand die graag slimmer wordt via opleiding en begeleiding on the job.
  • Iemand die nieuwe werkwijzen en technieken snel toepast in de praktijk.

Als grondwerker / wegenwerker zal je werken aan grote projecten zoals tunnels, bruggen en stedelijke projecten. Dit binnen een stabiel team en met goede apparatuur om je werk soepel te laten verlopen.

Je takenpakket omvat onder meer:

  • Plaatsing van borduren
  • Rioolaansluiting
  • Algemene grondwerken
  • Beton uitschoten
  • Kolken plaatsen in het wegdek
  • Etc.

Je zal regelmatig in contact komen met buizen van 2 tot 3 meter breed. Daarom vereisen we ervaring met dergelijke grote materialen.

Een rijbewijs is verplicht binnen ons bedrijf, zodat je indien nodig het stuur kunt overnemen. Nacht- of weekendwerk kan worden gevraagd, met een extra toeslag op het loon. Naast de standaardvergoeding ontvang je ook maaltijdcheques (€5.60/dag) en Benefits@Work.

Wij investeren in persoonlijke groei en bieden tal van opleidingsmogelijkheden. 

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een sterke speler in de infrastructuursector?

  • Kennis van de Nederlandse taal
  • Ervaring binnen grond / wegenwerken
  • Rijbewijs B

Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij iemand die energie haalt uit buiten werken, afwisseling en zichtbaar resultaat? Zoek je een job waarin je niet achter een bureau zit, maar elke dag meebouwt aan infrastructuur die écht gebruikt wordt? In deze functie combineer je techniek, beweging en verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent vaak onderweg, werkt op uiteenlopende locaties en geen dag voelt hetzelfde aan. Je krijgt vertrouwen, ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en maakt tegelijk deel uit van een team dat voor elkaar klaarstaat. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en trots op je werk staan centraal. Deze job is ideaal voor wie graag praktisch bezig is, houdt van machines en voldoening haalt uit werk dat tastbaar is. jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Sociology, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- The (conflict-ridden) negotiation of imaginaries, infrastructures, institutional frameworks, and/or externalities (e.g., emissions, waste, waste heat) associated with energy production and supply across a wide variety of practices, communities, networks, organizations, markets, fields, and/or assemblagesTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Sociology or a comparable field in the social sciences, as well as relevant previous experience in the sociological analysis of the environment, technology, or energy, and/or in the field of Science and Technology Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatoryWe offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship  in the field of Civil and Digital Law (Jurist/in)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Civil and Digital Law. Primary supervision will be provided by Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Juniorprofessorship in Civil Law, Intellectual Property Law, especially Patent Law and Legal Issues of AI.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Civil and Digital Law, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Energy- and resource-intensive digital infrastructures as a subject of EU regulation- Systemic risks of digital platforms and AI systems in the context of energy use, resource consumption, and ecological sustainability, particularly under the Digital Services Act and the AI Act- Ecological sustainability as a European value and as an interpretative principle in digital law- Law and legal culture as elements of energy and technology cultures, particularly the interactions between legal categories, technological development, societal transformations, and concepts of sustainability- Territorial and extraterritorial limits of European digital regulation in addressing global ecological impactsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Civil and Digital Law. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an above-average university degree in law and have prior knowledge of, or at least a strong interest in, the regulation of digital services and AI, as well as in the role of energy (cultures) and/or ecological sustainability. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the applicable doctoral regulations, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-004, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of International Politics (Politologe/Politologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of International Politics. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Chair of Political Science with a focus on International Politics.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of International Politics, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Research on the transnational transition of energy cultures by linking Political Science and International Relations with Social Movement Studies, Sociology, or Conflict Studies- Energy transformation as a political and social distributional conflict in the context of global governance and transnational networks- Challenges of cross-border labour relations in the context of the energy transition, and as objects of analysis for Global Social Policy, Transnational Advocacy Networks, and international norm research- Analysis of legitimation strategies for international objectives (e.g., CO2 reduction) at the national and local levels, particularly in the context of labour- Investigation of global and transnational issues in local contexts, for example through the application of qualitative, comparative, and ethnographic methodsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Political Science/International Relations/Political Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Political Science or a comparable social science discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the application of social science methods as well as in the fields of International Politics and Social Movement Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters), and, where applicable, details of your family situation. Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-003, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Strategic Procurement Manager - Semiconductor Materials (f/m/d) (Category-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.About our technologyThe semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; German language skills are considered an advantage.- Willing to work on-site at our Aachen office at least once a week.Our work culturePeople Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what mattersLet’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal developmentYour Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and futureWe Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forwardWe connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connectIf your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here. (https://www.blacksemi.com/privacy-policy)Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 70%

In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.PURPOSE OF THE ROLEThe role is situated within IRC's Mass Market Fundraising Team (MMDE), which is responsible for the acquisition, development and stewardship of individual donors in Germany, with the primary goal of maximizing the lifetime value of new and existing donors.As Senior officer Fundraising development, you play a key role in planning and creating content and communications that inspire donations and promote an engaging donor experience. Your work focuses on strengthening donor engagement and increasing fundraising revenue. You will work across two connected pillars, namely content development and programme development, that together drive donor acquisition, retention and development for IRC Germany.MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES- Create engaging content for donor journeys and donor communications across- digital acquisition, email, direct mail, and telemarketing to increase donations- and donor engagement.- across IRC Germany's- fundraising efforts, and use the findings to guide content and testing decisions- and give prospects and supporters a great digital experience.- Take responsibility for how your activity performs against agreed KPIs and- income targets, and make sure campaign reports capture learnings for future activity.YOUR PROFILEEssential:- Relevant university degree or equivalent
