jobs.title: IT IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER - SALESFORCE VS TEMENOS (H/F)
jobs.description: IT IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT MANAGER - SALESFORCE VS TEMENOS Contexte : Dans le cadre d'un programme stratégique de transformation de ses processus crédits, notre client, un acteur bancaire luxembourgeois, souhaite renforcer son dispositif de pilotage avec un Program IT Delivery Lead capable de conduire le delivery IT d'un programme complexe à fort impact métier, organisationnel et humain. Le programme vise notamment : La refonte et l'optimisation des processus de crédit de bout en bout L'amélioration de l'expérience client et des délais de traitement La digitalisation, l'automatisation et la standardisation des parcours L'accompagnement des équipes et la coordination d'un large écosystème de parties prenant/antes métiers, IT et prestataires externes Votre Mission : Vous reprendrez la gestion projet/opérationnelle du delivery d'un programme en cours, actuellement en phase d'implémentation de son premier lot (suivie des tests d'intégration, de l'UAT puis du roll-out en Production). Vous évoluerez avec une trentaine de parties prenant/antes : un stream « delivery métier », un stream « delivery IT » (équipes internes et externes de développement, d'architecture, BA techniques, QA.) et un intégrateur externe. Rattaché(e) au Head of Commercial and Digital Solutions, vous vous coordonnerez avec le Program Lead, le Lead métier et l'intégrateur externe. Le delivery IT couvre principalement l'implémentation de la solution Front Crédit nCino (Salesforce), l'intégration avec le Core Banking Temenos, les flux Data (nCino, datawarehouse.) et l'organisation des phases de tests (sprint, intégration, UAT). Vos responsabilités principales : Revoir et optimiser les méthodologies de planification/estimation, d'implémentation et de test Gérer le stream en mode projet dans le cadre de la gouvernance globale du programme Rapporter et faire valider toutes les décisions au Head of Commercial and Digital Solutions Structurer et optimiser toutes les activités (spécifications, développements, testing, déploiement.) en mesurant les résultats via des KPI Mener la résolution des points bloquants et aligner les parties sur les objectifs Suivre les actions, décisions, planning, budget, dépendances, problèmes et risques du stream Rentrer dans les sujets fonctionnels pour être force de proposition sur des alternatives argumentées (fonctionnel, effort, technique) Votre profil : Vous combinez expérience bancaire, excellente capacité d'analyse, rigueur d'exécution et aptitude démontrée à mener des programmes à fort enjeu jusqu'à l'acceptance métier. Leadership & Influence : Expérience avérée dans le pilotage du delivery d'un programme de transformation Leadership naturel et forte capacité de mobilisation d'équipes multidisciplinaires Excellente gestion des parties prenant/antes , y compris le management exécutif Capacité à prendre des décisions difficiles, conduire les arbitrages et débloquer les situations Maîtrise de la planification, du suivi des jalons, des risques et des dépendances Capacité à produire des tableaux de bord, KPI et rapports de pilotage Delivery & Exécution : Expérience avérée des phases Build, SIT, UAT et Go-Live sur des packages similaires à Salesforce et Temenos Forte orientation résultats et capacité à revoir les méthodologies Excellente maîtrise de la planification, de la priorisation et de l'escalade Analyse & Compétences Personnelles : Excellentes capacités analytiques, rigueur méthodologique et esprit de synthèse Approche pragmatique et orientée solution Bonne connaissance des processus bancaires, du contexte réglementaire et des enjeux de transformation du secteur financier Capacité à travailler  et à gérer plusieurs chantiers en parallèle Autonomie, proactivité et orientation client Maîtrise des langues : français indispensable, anglais professionnel courant. Luxembourgeois ou allemand : un atout. Envoyez votre candidature comprenant une lettre de motivation et un C.V. détaillé à  ou contactez-nous directement au +   pour plus de renseignements. Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

Mitwirkung bei der Zusammenarbeit des Freistaates Sachsen mit Polen- Unterstützung der Leitung und der allgemeinen Geschäfte des Verbindungsbüros,- Korrespondenz mit Projektpartnern,- Übersetzungs- und einfache Dolmetschertätigkeiten,- Recherchen zu diversen Themen der deutsch-polnischen Zusammenarbeit,1. Bearbeitung von Haushaltsangelegenheiten wie Haushaltsplanung und Haushaltsentwicklung, Mittelbewirtschaftung,2. allgemeine Bürosachbearbeitung, insbesondere- Terminplanung, Fristenkontrolle,- Verwaltung der Korrespondenz,- organisatorische Absprachen mit den Dienstleistern des Verbindungsbüros Breslau,- Reiseorganisation, Empfang von Besucherinnen und Besucher sowie Gästen,- Führen und Auswerten von Statistiken, Datenbankpflege,1. Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Veranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Sitzungen des Verbindungsbüros einschließlich der Erstellung von Präsentationsunterlagen und Protokollen, Einholung von Angeboten und Durchführung von Beschaffungen,2. Mitwirkung bei der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit des Verbindungsbüros, insbesondere bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Informationsmaterialien und des Internetauftritts.Wir bieten Ihnen - einen vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Arbeitsplatz bei einer obersten Landesbehörde,- regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten,- für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance flexible und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten sowie grundsätzlich die Möglichkeit der Teilzeitbeschäftigung,- 30 Tage Urlaub, Überstundenausgleich, 24. und 31. Dezember arbeitsfrei,- ein betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement mit Angeboten zur betrieblichen Gesundheitsförderung,- betriebliche Altersvorsorge bei der VBL,- moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsplatzausstattung,- Vergütung und Sozialleistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder im Bereich der Entgeltgruppe 9a.Sie bringen mit Zwingende Voraussetzungen für die Tätigkeit sind (bitte Nachweis beifügen):- eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder- ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (z. B. der Fachrichtungen Germanistik, Politik-, Wirtschafts-, Kommunikations- oder Rechtswissenschaften, Internationale Beziehungen, Europastudien) und- sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Polnisch (bei Fremdsprache bitte Nachweis beifügen).Von Vorteil Für die Ausübung Ihrer Tätigkeit sind von Vorteil:- sehr gute praxisorientierte, anwenderbezogene IT-Kenntnisse (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Internet-Recherche),- Kenntnisse im Haushaltsrecht,- grundlegende Englischkenntnisse,- berufliche Erfahrung bei der Organisation von Veranstaltungen und Projekten,- eine nachgewiesene Berufserfahrung im öffentlichen Dienst oder einer vergleichbaren administrativen Tätigkeit,- Erfahrung in der grenzüberschreitenden, europäischen oder internationalen Zusammenarbeit.Darüber hinaus erwarten wir: - ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit,- hohe Flexibilität, Eigeninitiative und Einsatzbereitschaft,- gutes Zeit- und Selbstmanagement,- Organisationsgeschick,- Belastbarkeit,- Interkulturelle Kompetenz,- sicheres und höfliches Auftreten und freundlicher und gewandter Umgang im Publikumsverkehr.Ihre Bewerbung Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?  Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, Nachweise von Abschlüssen, Qualifikationsnachweise, Arbeitszeugnisse) unter der Kennziffer 20/26 BSB SK 31 als PDF-Datei per E-Mail an post@sk.sachsen.de.Bitte fügen Sie deutsche Übersetzungen bei, sofern Ihre Nachweise in einer Fremdsprache verfasst sind.  Fassen Sie die Anlagen in einer PDFDatei (max. 10 MB) zusammen.  Alternativ können Sie Ihre Bewerbung gerne auch postalisch an dieSächsische Staatskanzlei, Referat 11 – Personal, Archivstraße 1, 01097 Dresden übersenden.Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, die bereits beim Freistaat Sachsen beschäftigt sind, Verfügung.Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung und ihnen gleichgestellte Personen berücksichtigen wir bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt.  Gehören Sie zu diesem Personenkreis, fügen Sie bitte Ihrer Bewerbung jobs.title: Ingénieur / Ingénieure en mécanique de production (H/F)
jobs.description: Mission : Pré-études numériques en mécanique et thermique, conception (CAO) et accommodation de design pour différents types d'instruments (radars, lidars). Fabrication, intégration et tests mécaniques/optomécaniques. Suivi de réalisation et interface avec les prestataires. Mise au point et pilotage d'expérience optomécaniques.Activités : - Établir avec les demandeurs la définition et la faisabilité des projets ou des instruments, les finaliser sous forme d'un cahier des charges fonctionnelles.- Analyser les besoins des équipes projets et traduire ces besoins en termes de conception mécanique sous logiciel de Conception Assistée par Ordinateur (CAO).- Réaliser la conception des systèmes mécaniques sur les outils logiciels de CAO du laboratoire (NX Siemens, catia.).- Connaissance en analyses mécaniques (calculs de structure, modélisation par éléments finis, ...) et thermique (modélisation numérique).- Savoir établir des dossiers de fabrication (cotation fonctionnelle, tolérancement, éditions de plans 2D).- Intégrer à ces études les spécialités connexes à la mécanique et à la thermique telles que les techniques du vide et l'optique.- Rédiger les documents techniques liés à ces activités.- Participer et suivre la fabrication des systèmes mécaniques en interne et en sous-traitance.- Assurer l'intégration des systèmes mécaniques au sein des différents instruments.- Traduire les cahiers des charges en spécifications techniques.- Collaborer à la mise en place et appliquer les processus qualité.

Als Marktführer in der Gemeinschaftsverpflegung in Österreich und Betreiber renommierter Gastronomiebetriebe sowie Cateringpartner für Veranstaltungen jeder Größenordnung steht GOURMET für kulinarische Kompetenz und Verlässlichkeit.   Was uns ausmacht? Ein Miteinander, das verbindet, und der Anspruch, jeden Tag Gutes besser zu machen. Bei uns arbeiten Sie... an der Zubereitung der Speisen nach hohen firmeninternen Standards an der Einhaltung von Hygiene- und Qualitätsrichtlinien an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen Wir freuen uns auf Sie und... Ihre Berufserfahrung in der Gastronomie oder im Lebensmittelbereich (von Vorteil) Ihre gesicherten Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Ihren Teamgeist, Ihre Einsatzbereitschaft und Flexibilität Wir machen Gutes besser... mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, wöchentlicher Wechseldienst im Rahmen von 05:00 - 20:00 Uhr (Montag bis Freitag), PKW aufgrund der Arbeitszeiten von Vorteil mit einem frischen und kostenlosen Mittagessen vor Ort mit der Möglichkeit weiteres Essen gratis mit nach Hause zu nehmen mit einer fundierten und umfangreichen Einschulung für einen erfolgreichen Start mit einem familiären Team und einem unkomplizierten Arbeitsalltag mit 50 % Nachtarbeitszuschlag vom Lohnstundensatz vor 06:00 Uhr und nach 20:00 Uhr mit fairer Entlohnung gemäß dem Kollektivvertrag Nahrungs- und Genussmittelindustrie für Arbeiter:innen, von monatlich mindestens EUR 2.302,93 brutto auf Basis einer 38,5-Stunden-Woche. Ob Berufseinstieg, Spezialisierung oder neue Perspektiven: Bei GOURMET eröffnen sich vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu bieten wir attraktive Vorteile für Mitarbeiter:innen, verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, das unterschiedliche Lebenssituationen berücksichtigt. Durch Ihren Bewerbungsprozess führt Sie Alexa Gabriel. Bei Fragen oder Anliegen nehmen Sie sehr gerne direkt Kontakt auf. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

jobs.title: R&D Engineer (m/f/d), (80-100%)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
jobs.description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional.

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an engineer who rapidly turns promising image- and video-generation techniques into evaluated, shipped MyArchitectAI features. This is hands-on product building: not pure research, and not a pure inference/infrastructure job. - In your first 30 days you ship a meaningful improvement, scoped with a founder: a new AI capability, a quality or speed gain, an evaluation system, or automation of manual work. You back it with visual examples and numbers. - By 60 days you find an opportunity yourself (new models, user data, weak spots in our pipeline), propose it and ship it. - By 90 days you have three or more shipped contributions and own the loop: find → evaluate → build → validate → ship → learn. - You keep a clear view of new models, techniques and competitors without chasing novelty for its own sake.

We offer: - Working directly with the founders, with real impact on the product.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Salary negotiable.

Other requirements: You have:- Hands-on work with generative image or video models (not only LLMs, RAG or agents). - At least one shipped product, deployed feature, meaningful open-source contribution, or convincing end-to-end project, and you can say exactly what you built. - Experience running experiments and making quality vs. speed vs. cost decisions. - The engineering skills to take a notebook or demo into a real product (Python, production-quality code). - Good written English (our working language). Estonian is not required. Nice to have: Diffusers, ComfyUI, ControlNet-style conditioning, inpainting and editing, LoRA and fine-tuning, video models, upscaling; your own evaluation datasets or benchmarks; GPU deployment and optimisation; 3D, AEC, CAD, rendering or interiors; public code, demos, models or write-ups.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €123,000-€138,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. Haluatko tehdä töitä, joissa kädenjälkesi näkyy ja osaamisesi kasvaa? Saat vastuullesi henkilö- ja pakettiautojen - huollot, korjaukset ja vaativammat vianhaut. Kerro, mitä olet tehnyt itse ja missä tarvitset vielä ohjausta. - Ymmärrät turvallisen työskentelyn merkityksen, kysyt ajoissa ja haluat oppia tekemään työn oikein. - Pelkkä kiinnostus autoihin tai toisten korjaamisen seuraaminen ei riitä tähän tehtävään. Kun perusta on kunnossa, opetamme lisää ja autamme sinua kehittymään itsenäiseksi asentajaksi.

jobs.title: Apuvälineteknikko - Sahlgrenskan yliopistollinen sairaala, Göteborg
jobs.description: Apuvälineteknikko, haluaisitko työskennellä apuvälinetekniikan parissa yhdessä Ruotsin johtavista yliopistosairaaloista? Etsimme sinua Göteborgiin Sahlgrenskan yliopistolliseen sairaalaan vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti potilaiden kanssa, osana moniammatillista tiimiä sekä osallistumaan apuvälinetekniikan ja apuvälineitä hyödyntävän hoidon kehittämiseen. Työ sopii sinulle, jos nautit potilastyöstä, arvostat hyvää tiimityötä ja haluat hyödyntää osaamistasi kehittyvässä ja innovatiivisessa työympäristössä.Millaisesta työstä on kyse?Sahlgrenskan apuvälinetekniikan yksikkö valmistaa ja sovittaa potilaille yksilöllisiä ortopedisiä apuvälineitä, kuten proteeseja, ortooseja ja tukipohjallisia. Yksikössä työskentelee noin 55 ammattilaista.Apuvälineteknikkona työskentelet tiiviisti potilaiden kanssa ja teet yhteistyötä muiden teknikoiden, muiden terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä alueen kuntoutusyksiköiden kanssa.Kehittäminen on aidosti osa työtä. Yksikössä on käynnissä muun muassa 3D-teknologian hyödyntämiseen liittyvä projekti, ja erilaisiin kehitysprojekteihin ja osaamisen kehittämiseen käytetään noin puoli päivää viikossa. Myös tutkimus- ja kehittämistyön ja kliinisen työn yhdistämiseen kannustetaan.Mitä toivomme sinulta?Edellytämme, että olet laillistettu apuvälineteknikko ja sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva apuvälineteknikon koulutus tai vastaava koulutus ja kokemus. Sinulla tulee olla kokemusta ortopedisiä apuvälineitä tarvitsevien potilaiden kohtaamisesta. Aiempi kokemus proteesityöstä katsotaan eduksi.Lisäksi toivomme sinulta:- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja- Potilaslähtöistä työskentelyotetta- Kykyä kuunnella ja kohdata potilaat sekä heidän läheisensä- Joustavuutta ja organisointikykyä- Kykyä suunnitella ja priorisoida omaa työtäsi- Palveluhenkisyyttä, vastuullisuutta ja laatutietoista työotettaMitä tarjoamme sinulle?Pääset osaksi noin 55 ammattilaisen apuvälineyksikköä, jossa kliininen työ yhdistyy moniammatilliseen yhteistyöhön, tutkimukseen, innovaatioihin ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.Työ on päivätyötä ja käytössä on joustava työaikajärjestelmä. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja työsuhteen alussa käytetään koeaikaa. Aloitus tapahtuu sopimuksen mukaan ja palkka määritellään henkilökohtaisesti. Ruotsin kielen koulutus ennen muuttoa (jos sinulla on aiempaa kielitaitoa, on prosessi paljon nopeampi!) Vakituinen työsuhde Täysi tuki muutossa, asunnossa ja ammattiluvissa (Socialstyrelsen) Mahdollisuus yhdistää kliininen työ tutkimukseenMe Medikaislalla toimimme rekrytointikumppanina, mutta työsuhde solmitaan suoraan Sahlgrenskan sairaalan kanssa. Työsuhteen tiedot Työpaikan sijainti: Göteborg, Ruotsi Työaika: Kokoaikainen, 100 % Työsuhde: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, suora työsuhde Sahlgrenskan sairaalaan Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan Palkkaus: Kokemuksen mukaan Työympäristö: Sahlgrenskan yliopistollisen sairaalan apuvälineyksikköKiinnostuitko?Jos haluat hyödyntää osaamistasi monipuolisessa potilastyössä ja päästä samalla mukaan kehittämään tulevaisuuden apuvälineratkaisuja, tämä voi olla juuri sinun seuraava työpaikkasi. Jätä hakemuksesi ja tule mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä Göteborgiin!Lisätietoa tehtävästä ja hakuprosessista antaa mielelläänRekrytointikonsultti Sanni Alanen044 493 5850sanni.alanen@eilakaisla.fiMedikaislaMedikaisla on terveydenhuollon HR-kumppani. Uskomme, että mitä paremmin terveydenhuollon asiantuntijat voivat työssään, sitä parempaa hoitoa potilaat saavat ja sitä paremmin me kaikki voimme.Me medikaislalaiset olemme sitkeitä optimisteja. Tehtävämme on rakentaa entistä parempia terveydenhuollon työyhteisöjä saattamalla oikeat terveydenhuollon asiantuntijat oikeaan paikkaan ja tukemalla heitä työssään. Teemme työtämme suurella pieteetillä kaikkia kunnioittaen. Työntekijöitämme, asiakkaitamme ja yhteistyökumppaneitamme palvelee tehokas tiimi Turussa.Autamme asiakkaitamme terveydenhuoltopalveluiden järjestämisessä tarjoamalla osaavia ammattilaisia: lääkäreitä, erikoislääkäreitä, hammaslääkäreitä ja hoitajia. Toimimme julkisen ja yksityisen puolen asiakkaidemme yhteistyökumppanina. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme mahdollisuuden keskittyä työssään kaikkein olennaisimpaan tukemalla heitä heidän rekrytointiprosesseissaan ja -tarpeissaan.Puhelin: 0291701370 Sähköposti: medi@eilakaisla.fi Sijainti: Yliopistonkatu 26, 20100 Turku Tehtävään liittyvissä kysymyksissä tai mikäli hakemisessa on teknisiä ongelmia, olethan yhteydessä ilmoituksessa mainittuun tiimiin.Onnea työnhakuun!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Sustainable and Resilient Freight Transport Systems
jobs.description: [Se nedan för svenska]The Hanken School of Economics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher as a project researcher for 8 months to conduct research in the project Society Quest for a Resilient and Sustainable Nordic Freight Transport SystemFunded by the Peter Wallenberg Foundation, the project explores how to strengthen the resilience and environmental sustainability of Nordic freight transport and supply chains. Through parallel Society Quest processes in Finland and Sweden, researchers and societal stakeholders will jointly identify key challenges and develop priorities for future research, development, and Nordic collaboration. Society Quest is a structured co-creation method in which researchers, industry and public-sector actors move step by step from articulating a shared societal challenge to concrete directions for joint action. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop both your academic profile and your experience of working at the interface between research and practice.Postdoc responsibilities:- Plan and carry out the Finnish Society Quest, in close collaboration with the Hanken and Linköping University research teams and supporting the Swedish implementation of the Society Quest.- Map and engage relevant stakeholders across industry, public authorities, transport infrastructure actors, and the research community.- Recruit Society Quest participants and coordinate stakeholder engagement- Contribute to the design and facilitation of Society Quest co-creation workshops addressing resilient and environmentally sustainable freight transport.- Systematically document and analyze findings in cooperation with the project researchers.- Contribute to project dissemination.- Preparation of journal manuscript(s) based on project results.- The position includes some teaching responsibilities, up to 15 % of work timeThe successful candidate is expected to have:- A doctoral degree in supply chain management, logistics, transportation, sustainability, or another relevant field.- Knowledge of, or a strong research interest in, supply chain resilience, sustainable transport, freight transport, or closely related topics.- Experience with qualitative and/or participatory research methods, for example, interviews, workshops, focus groups, co-creation, or stakeholder-engaged research.- The ability to independently organize and carry out empirical research, including stakeholder identification, recruitment, data collection, documentation, and analysis.- Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to work with both academic and non-academic actors.- Excellent written and oral English-language skills.Considered an advantage:- Existing experience interacting with companies, public authorities, infrastructure actors, or other societal stakeholders.- Experience with workshop facilitation or co-creation methodologies.- Knowledge of resilience and sustainability research and their intersection.- Finnish and/or Swedish language skills.- Existing high-quality academic publications- Teaching experience- Industry experienceThrough the position, you will have the opportunity to:- Contribute to a Nordic research project and shape its implementation.- Develop expertise in resilient and sustainable freight transport.- Build networks with academic, industry, and public-sector actors in Finland and Sweden.- Gain experience in co-creation, stakeholder engagement, and cross-national research.- Contribute to academic publications, societal impact, and the development of future research.- Gain academic teaching experience.Eligibility criteria:Eligibility requirements: Applicants for this position are required to have (a) a PhD degree in a relevant subject and (b) a fluent command of English. Applicants close to their PhD defense can be considered if the defense date is decided. Possibility to start latest by February 2027.The position is for 8 months, depending on when you can start (earliest start: January 2027). By joining the Supply Chain Management & Social Responsibility subject at Hanken, you will benefit from and contribute to a thriving scientific environment at a triple crown-accredited university business school (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA accreditations), becoming part of a group of highly active researchers with high productivity in publishing, numerous global projects, and a strong international profile.The annual working time in this position is 1612 hours. The location of the positions is in Helsinki (https://www.hel.fi/helsinki/enhttps://www.hel.fi/en), and we expect you to move to Finland.The salary for the project researcher is based on the university salary system in Finland (including employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions); the exact salary level depends upon the recruited individuals qualifications and performance. The entry-level salary is in the range of 46.800 - 52.500 euro/year. Benefits include occupational health care.The application should include the following attachments:- Motivation letter stating how youd contribute to the project- CV incl. min. 2 references who can be contacted for recommendations- PhD degree certificate- Publication list incl. working doi links to selected, max 5 recent publications (or if links dont work, separately submitted publications in pdf form)The application shall be submitted electronically to Hankens recruitment database Laura no later than November 16th 2026. In addition, other relevant documents (e.g. certificates, recommendations) may be submitted with the application. Please indicate when you would be able to start in the position if you should be selected.Enquiries may be directed to the project team:- Associate Professor Anna Aminoff, anna.aminoff@hanken.fi- Assistant Professor Helleke Heikkinen, [helleke.heikkinen@hanken.fi](mailto:Helleke.heikkinen@hanken.fi)The Hanken School of Economics reserves the right, for justified reasons, to leave the position open, to extend the application period, and to consider candidates who have not submitted applications during the application period. Hanken School of Economics reserves the right to close the application period early if a suitable candidate is identified and appointed.Further information:Project profiles under the ongoing projects of the HUMLOG In

jobs.title: Automation Engineer / Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Position: Automation Engineer / Senior Automation Engineer****Location:** Kotka, Finland**Department:** Maintenance**Position Type:** Full-time**About the Role:**We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Automation Engineer to join our Equipment Department at the new CAM battery materials plant in Kotka. Joining us during the critical installation and commissioning phase, you will work directly with our engineering teams on the shop floor to master the factory's control systems. As the plant transitions into full operation, you will serve as the core technical pillar, responsible for maintaining, modifying, and optimizing automation logic to ensure continuous and efficient production.**Key Responsibilities:**_PLC/DCS Programming & Troubleshooting_: Independently conduct root-cause diagnostics, program modifications, and code optimization for Siemens PCS7 (DCS) and S7-1200/1500 (PLC) systems to rapidly resolve daily production downtimes._Field Loop & Drive Diagnostics_: Perform hands-on field testing of I/O signals, PID loop tuning, and parameter configuration/troubleshooting for variable frequency drives (VFDs) and other field instrumentation._System Interface Execution_: Establish and configure data links, address mapping, and industrial communication protocols between main process systems and third-party units (e.g., AHU, Fire Alarm Interlocks, Schneider HV SCADA monitoring, and Security/IIoT platforms)._Technical Scoping & Vendor Review_: Define precise technical requirements (control logic diagrams, I/O lists, communication standards) for outsourced system modifications. Review vendor-submitted codes and lead the technical execution of Factory and Site Acceptance Tests (FAT/SAT)._Commissioning & Handover_: Maintain a strong presence on the shop floor during the current installation phase. Work alongside the EPC team to thoroughly understand the underlying code and system architecture, ensuring a seamless technical handover to the operations team with zero knowledge gaps.**Qualifications & Technical Requirements:**_Experience:_ 5 to 10 years of robust, hands-on experience in industrial automation programming, commissioning, and field troubleshooting within heavy industry, chemical, or similar highly automated manufacturing environments._Education vs. Capability_: A relevant degree (**B.Sc**. or **M.Sc**.) in Automation or Electrical Engineering is preferred; however, proven hands-on capability, coding proficiency, and extensive field experience are valued above formal education._Core Expertise_: Deep, proven practical experience with Siemens PCS7 and TIA Portal is mandatory._Troubleshooting Skills_: Exceptional diagnostic skills with the ability to independently resolve complex control loops, drive faults, and industrial communication network issues._System Architecture_: Solid understanding of OT network architectures, industrial communication protocols (e.g., Profinet, Modbus, OPC UA), and safe data integration practices._Mindset_: A proactive, shop-floor-oriented problem solver who thrives on direct technical execution rather than pure administrative management._Language_: Fluent in English (corporate language); Finnish or Chinese language proficiency is a strong advantage.**What We Offer:**\- A key technical role in a state-of-the-art greenfield project within the booming European battery materials industry.\- A competitive salary package commensurate with your hands-on expertise and seniority.\- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and a collaborative, international working culture.**If** you are interested in this position, please apply at your earliest convenience. We are looking to fill this role as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Utility Engineer
jobs.description: **Position: Utility Engineer****Employer: Easpring Finland New Materials Oy****Location of work: Kotka, Finland (on-site)****About the Role**We are looking for a Utility Engineer to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of utility systems at our battery materials plant in Kotka, Finland. You will manage daily system performance, develop maintenance plans, and work with maintenance teams and service providers to ensure a stable utility supply for production.**Key Responsibilities**- Oversee the daily operation and maintenance of plant utility systems, including cooling and chilled water, compressed air, HVAC, water treatment, and electrical power distribution. - Monitor cooling water system performance and manage water quality in line with applicable requirements, including sampling, treatment programmes, and coordination with water treatment service providers. - Develop and implement preventive maintenance plans, organise periodic inspections and servicing, and ensure scheduled maintenance is completed and recorded. - Investigate utility system faults, coordinate troubleshooting and repairs, and follow up on corrective actions to prevent recurring problems. - Coordinate with production, control room operators, maintenance teams, and external contractors to plan work and minimise interruptions to production. - Maintain equipment information, maintenance records, and critical spare parts requirements, and identify opportunities to improve system reliability and energy efficiency. **Requirements**- Practical experience in operating and maintaining utility systems in a factory or similar industrial environment. - Good working knowledge of cooling water systems, including system operation, water quality requirements, monitoring, and treatment methods. - Familiarity with compressed air systems, HVAC, and industrial electrical power distribution. - Ability to plan and coordinate preventive maintenance, periodic servicing, and equipment repairs. - A relevant technical qualification in mechanical, electrical, energy, automation engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - A practical approach to problem-solving, a strong focus on safety, and good teamwork and coordination skills. - English communication skills suitable for daily work and technical discussions. **Additional Experience We Value**Experience with maintenance management systems (CMMS), utility system commissioning, or industrial water treatment would be an advantage.We welcome candidates from different industrial backgrounds. You do not need to be a specialist in every utility system, but you should have a solid foundation in industrial utility operations and a willingness to develop your knowledge further.**Application process**We will review applications on an ongoing basis and will fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found. There is no fixed application deadline, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.Join us on our exciting journey ahead. We welcome talented individuals who want to be part of our team.

jobs.title: Environmental and Fire Safety Technician
jobs.description: **Position:** Environmental and Fire System Technician**Employer:** Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**Location of work:** Kotka, Finland (on-site)**About Easpring Finland**Easpring Finland is developing a battery materials plant in Kotka to meet the growing demand for battery materials in Europe. The plant will produce cathode active materials required for electric vehicle batteries.We are now looking for an **Environmental and Fire Safety Technician** to join our HSE team.**Position Summary**As an Environmental and Fire Safety Technician, you will play a key role in managing Easprings environmental matters, including the implementation of the environmental monitoring plan, internal and external regulatory reporting, and fire safety systems.The role involves daily monitoring, documentation and troubleshooting of environmental and fire protection systems, as well as coordination of related service providers. Statutory inspections, specialized maintenance, system modifications and the interpretation of regulatory requirements remain the responsibility of qualified experts and HSE management.This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to the development of the HSE culture at Easpring Finland New Materials Oy.The position is ideal for a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working with environmental tasks, technical troubleshooting and practical activities outside a traditional office environment.**Key Responsibilities**The role involves taking responsibility for the practical day-to-day management of the following areas:**1\. Environmental Matters and Reporting (Internal and External)**- Oversee the implementation of the environmental monitoring plan and prepare weekly, monthly and annual reports. - Carry out environmental sampling and arrange the dispatch of samples for analysis. - Support internal and external regulatory reporting related to environmental matters. **2\. Fire Alarm System**- Monitor the operation of the fire alarm control panel and ensure that the system remains continuously operational. - Respond appropriately to fault, maintenance and alarm situations and take measures to prevent false alarms. - Act as the main operator for the fire alarm system. - Coordinate matters related to the connection to the emergency response centre, including contracts, contact persons and equipment-related matters. **3\. Gas Protection System**- Act as the designated operator for the gas extinguishing system and ensure its continuous operational readiness and safe operation. - Carry out the responsibilities assigned to the person designated by the property owner or holder. **4\. Sprinkler System**- Be responsible for the daily monitoring and maintenance of the property's automatic sprinkler system. - Ensure inspections and other activities are carried out in accordance with applicable legislation and the maintenance programme. - Monitor the operational readiness of the system and coordinate related maintenance activities. **5\. Smoke Hatch System**- Be responsible for the regular monitoring of the property's smoke extraction system. - Supervise maintenance activities and ensure that relevant documentation is maintained. **6\. Fire Extinguishers**- Be responsible for the statutory inspections, maintenance and pressure testing of the property's portable fire extinguishers in cooperation with an external service provider. **7\. Civil Defence Shelter**- Be responsible for the company's civil defence shelter, including its condition, equipment, availability and maintenance programme. **8\. Hot Work**- Act as the designated hot work supervisor. **Requirements**- Suitable vocational or technical education and strong practical experience, preferably in Chemical, Process, Energy, Environmental Engineering or a related field. - Several years of hands-on experience in the chemical process industry or another continuous process industry. - Good understanding of core safety regulations, technical diagnostics and monitoring equipment, as well as practical experience in maintaining and inspecting complex protection systems. - Practical experience in the installation, maintenance and commissioning of fire safety and environmental systems and other safety and protection systems. - Full professional proficiency in Finnish. This technical role requires a strong understanding of Finnish environmental and local fire safety legislation, the ability to maintain detailed building maintenance documentation, familiarity with local compliance requirements, and the ability to communicate directly with building owners and emergency services. Fluent written and spoken Finnish is therefore a strict requirement for the role. - Professional proficiency in Finnish and practical working proficiency in English. **What We Offer**- An opportunity to join a fast-growing battery materials company. - A key role in developing Easpring's HSE culture and contributing to work that matters for environmental and fire safety in the future of the battery materials industry. - An international working environment combined with strong local operational responsibility. - Competitive compensation and benefits package. **Application process** We will review applications on an ongoing basis and will fill the position as soon as a suitable candidate is found. jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description: Priority deadline: October 27. Complete the short form at https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn, then email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the subject line "EA application, FULL NAME." STILLART · FULL TIME · SOUTHERN FINLAND, WITH WEEKLY TIME IN PERSONFor two decades, StillArt has helped orchestras and arts organizations fill their halls. The company works. What it needs now is someone to protect the mind behind it.A COMPANY ON SOLID GROUND StillArt (Finland) and its associated companies are established and profitable, with about €2 million in annual turnover, a team of four, and two dozen suppliers in a dozen countries. Unique products and clear plans for international growth mean this role grows as the companies do.THE ROLE As Executive Assistant, you guard the CEO's energy, momentum and focus, so his hours go where they are worth the most: winning clients, solving the problems only the CEO can solve, building the brand and starting what comes next. Everything that pulls him out of that zone, you take, and you take it so well he never has to look back. This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions. It is a partnership. You lead the daily rhythm, you arrive with the agenda, and within three months you are anticipating the next move.WHAT YOU WILL OWN This is a role with real ownership. From your first weeks, these are yours: The inbox. You triage, decide and reply, so only what truly needs the CEO reaches him. The calendar. You manage scheduling across the companies in the group, guard focus time and prepare the week ahead. Follow-through. Loose ends close because you close them, with the team, leads and clients. Momentum. You keep notes, actions and the project list moving, so the best ideas actually get implemented. Travel and events. Conferences, flights and hotels arranged to a high standard. Purchases and payments. Handled correctly, within limits the CEO sets. Voice and visibility. Social posts and copy coordinated with the right people. The daily rhythm. A short morning check-in and an end-of-day hand-off that previews tomorrow's one big thing. Planning together. You plan and prioritize alongside the CEO, with more independence as trust grows, and you serve as a sounding board when it is time to decide which ideas earn traction now.WHY THIS ROLE IS SOUGHT AFTER A seat beside the founder. You work directly with the CEO, close enough to shape the company's next chapter. A role built with you. The scope is designed around the person who takes it, and you carry the responsibility to build it. A 90-day path. A structured training program, in three stages, so you are never left guessing how to be impactful.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Calm in motion. Steady when plans change fast. Proactive by instinct. You see what needs doing before you are asked. Curious and always learning. New tools, new products, new markets, new ways of working, including AI. The CEO has a voracious appetite for learning. Entrepreneurial at heart. At home in a founder-led company where change moves quickly, and energized by growth. Experienced and discerning. You have run a busy executive's day before, as an executive assistant or in a similar supporting role, and senior team members take you seriously. Strong with people. A real listener who makes a room feel safe. You guide as much as you assist. Trusted with what matters. Discreet with sensitive information, trusted with visibility of company and personal money, and comfortable with finance basics. Careful with detail. You would rather get it right than get it fast. To show us, add the word intern to the last field on the application form. Fluent in Microsoft tools. StillArt runs on Microsoft 365, including Planner, OneDrive, Outlook and Copilot. You work in it with ease and, ideally, help the team get more out of it by showing how our processes can be set up. Warm, with boundaries. Helpful and friendly, and honest about what is sustainable. Culture oriented. You care about the arts and about being of service to arts organizations. Experience in the arts is a plus. At home across languages and cultures. English is a must. German is a strong advantage, as this is StillArt's long term target market. Swedish (the CEO's mother tongue) and Finnish (the dominant language of the home country) are valued, and other languages are welcome as the company grows globally.WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This role guards the CEO's time. It does not carry the sales pipeline, own bookkeeping or financial modeling, or run operations or manage the team. Those sit in other seats at StillArt.THE DETAILS Employer: StillArt Limited Ab Employment: Employee, full time, Monday to Friday, working roughly 9:00 to 17:00 Helsinki time Target start: Mid-November 2026 Location: Ideally based in Finland, able to meet in person once a week in Porvoo. Candidates living elsewhere in the EU, EEA or Switzerland are encouraged to apply. Working style: Mostly remote, with regular time in person, ideally weekly Salary range: €3,500 to €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience and languages. Open to more for a candidate who clearly shows the added value they bring.HOW TO APPLY Apply through the short form here: https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn. It takes about 10 minutes. After you submit it, please email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the role and your full name in the subject line. Example: EA application, FULL NAME. We review applications once both arrive, so early applications are strongly encouraged. Priority deadline: Oct 27. Applications received after that date may still be considered while the role remains open. StillArt is a founder-led firm in Porvoo, Finland that helps orchestras and performing arts organizations grow their audiences and revenue, with clients around the world. Learn more at stillart.com.

jobs.title: Ravintolapäällikkö, Amarillo Porvoo / Restaurangchef, Amarillo Borgå
jobs.description: Primary location:PORVOORAVINTOLAPÄÄLLIKKÖ 30–37,5 H/VK, AMARILLO PORVOOAmarillo Porvoo tarjoaa rennon ja elämyksellisen ravintolakokemuksen Porvoon sydämessä osana Varuboden-Oslaa – ihan tavallista työtä poikkeuksellisen monipuolisessa ympäristössä ja merkityksellisessä roolissa!Haemme ravintolapäällikköä määräaikaiseen sijaisuuteen 31.12.2027 asti vastaamaan Porvoon Amarillon ravintolatoiminnoista. Työaika on sovittavissa joustavasti 30–37,5 tuntiin viikossa.Etsimme tulosnälkäistä esihenkilöä, joka innostuu tavoitteista, myynnin kasvattamisesta ja erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisestä. Sinulle on luontevaa toimia esihenkilönä monikulttuurisessa työyhteisössä, johtaa esimerkillä eturivistä ja rakentaa myynnillistä palvelukulttuuria, jossa jokainen ymmärtää oman roolinsa tuloksen tekemisessä. Henkilöstön kehittäminen, valmentava johtaminen ja sujuvan arjen organisointi ovat vahvuuksiasi. Työ on vahvasti operatiivista, joten työskentelet pääsääntöisesti tiimisi rinnalla.Ravintolapäällikkönä vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti toiminnan laadusta, kannattavuudesta ja konseptin toimivuudesta. Johdat ja kehität asiakaspalvelua, tuotteiden laatua, työtyytyväisyyttä sekä myynti- ja liiketoimintatavoitteiden toteutumista kohti entistä parempia tuloksia ja elämyksiä.Mitä sinulta toivomme?- Aiempaa ravintola-alan esihenkilöosaamista ja kokemusta tulosvastuullisesta roolista.- Määrätietoisuutta, tuloshakuisuutta ja intoa kehittää myyntiä ja asiakaskokemusta.- Valmentavaa ja innostavaa johtamistyyliä sekä kykyä rakentaa myynnillistä palvelukulttuuria.- Kykyä organisoida arkea, kehittää henkilöstöä ja osallistua operatiiviseen työhön.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Työpaikan, johon on kiva tulla ja jossa on kiva olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee kavereita.- Tehtävän vaativuuden mukaisen palkan. Kokoaikaisessa, 37,5 tunnin viikkotyössä palkka on 3 600–4 000 €/kk, ja se määräytyy sovitun työajan, kokemuksen, koulutuksen ja kielitaidon perusteella.- Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen, enintään kahden kuukauden palkkaa vastaavaan päälliköiden tulospalkkioon sekä koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen, yrityksen tulokseen perustuvaan tulospalkkioon, joka on enintään 1,70 €/tehty työtunti.- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista, kuten ruoasta, juomasta, kosmetiikasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista ja hotelleista.- Mahdollisuuden vaihtaa tulevaisuudessa alaa tai tehtäviä saman työnantajan palveluksessa – mutta vain, jos haluat.Meillä ei tarvitse kiivetä uratikkaita, mutta joskus seuraava askelma vain puhuttelee. Jos näin on, hae nyt!Jätä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään sunnuntaina 1.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja kutsumme haastatteluihin jo hakuaikana. Emme huomioi sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia. Lisätietoja antaa ryhmäpäällikkö Jarno Sorasahi (jarno.sorasahi@sok.fi). Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään 1.1.2027.--------RESTAURANGCHEF 30–37,5 H/VECKA, AMARILLO BORGÅAmarillo Borgå erbjuder en avslappnad restaurangupplevelse med det lilla extra i hjärtat av Borgå som en del av Varuboden-Osla – ett helt vanligt jobb i en ovanligt mångsidig miljö och i en betydelsefull roll!Vi söker en restaurangchef för ett tidsbundet vikariat till och med 31.12.2027 med ansvar för restaurangverksamheten på Amarillo i Borgå. Arbetstiden kan avtalas flexibelt till 30–37,5 timmar i veckan.Vi söker en resultatinriktad chef som inspireras av tydliga mål, ökad försäljning och utvecklingen av en utmärkt kundupplevelse. Du känner dig hemma i chefsrollen i en mångkulturell arbetsgemenskap, leder genom eget exempel i det dagliga arbetet och bygger en försäljningsinriktad servicekultur där var och en förstår sin roll i att skapa resultat. Att utveckla personalen, leda coachande och organisera en smidig vardag hör till dina styrkor. Arbetet är i hög grad operativt, så du arbetar huvudsakligen sida vid sida med ditt team.Som restaurangchef ansvarar du för verksamhetens kvalitet och lönsamhet samt för att konceptet fungerar som det ska. Du leder och utvecklar kundservicen, produktkvaliteten och arbetstillfredsställelsen samt ser till att försäljnings- och affärsmålen nås. Målet är ännu bättre resultat och upplevelser.Vad önskar vi av dig?- Tidigare erfarenhet av chefsuppgifter inom restaurangbranschen och av en roll med resultatansvar.- Målmedvetenhet, resultatinriktning och vilja att utveckla försäljningen och kundupplevelsen.- Ett coachande och inspirerande sätt att leda samt förmåga att bygga en försäljningsinriktad servicekultur.- Förmåga att organisera vardagen, utveckla personalen och delta i det operativa arbetet.Vad erbjuder vi dig?- En arbetsplats som det är trevligt att komma till och vara på. Alla behöver inte vara en enda glad familj, men bli inte förvånad om kollegor blir vänner.- En lön som motsvarar uppdragets kravnivå. Vid heltidsarbete på 37,5 timmar i veckan är lönen 3 600–4 000 euro i månaden. Lönen fastställs utifrån den överenskomna arbetstiden, erfarenheten, utbildningen och språkkunskaperna.- Möjlighet till en årlig resultatpremie för chefer på högst två månadslöner samt till hela personalens gemensamma, företagsresultatbaserade resultatpremie på högst 1,70 euro per arbetad timme.- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, kosmetik, elektronik, restauranger och hotell.- Möjlighet att i framtiden byta bransch eller arbetsuppgifter hos samma arbetsgivare – men bara om du själv vill.Hos oss behöver du inte klättra på karriärstegen, men ibland känns nästa steg helt enkelt rätt. Om det gör det – sök nu!Lämna in din ansökan med löneanspråk senast söndag 1.11.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar och kallar till intervjuer redan under ansökningstiden. Ansökningar som skickas per e-post beaktas inte. För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta gruppchef Jarno Sorasahi (jarno.sorasahi@sok.fi). Arbetet börjar enligt avtal, dock senast 1.1.2027.

jobs.title: Lastvognsmekaniker – Padborg
jobs.description:
Skifter Lastbil A/S søger en dygtig lastvognsmekaniker med hænderne skruet rigtigt på til en fast stilling på vores værksted i Padborg. Er du uddannet lastvognsmekaniker, automekaniker eller landbrugsmaskinmekaniker eller lignende, tilbyder vi en spændende og alsidig hverdag med høj faglighed og gode kollegaer. En hverdag som lastvognsmekaniker hos os Dine primære opgaver bliver fejlsøgning, reparationer og serviceeftersyn på lastbiler. Hos os møder du dedikerede medarbejdere, en uformel omgangstone og hurtige beslutninger. Du bliver en del af et engageret team på 28 medarbejdere, hvor vi altid hjælper hinanden, og hvor kunden er i centrum. Du kommer til at arbejde med et bredt udvalg af opgaver på især Volvo- og Renault-lastbiler:
  • Fejlsøgning med originalt testudstyr samt reparation af strøm-, lys- og luftsystemer
  • Almindelig service, mekanisk vedligeholdelse, hydraulik og pneumatik
  • Klargøring og synsforberedelse
Dine kvalifikationer
  • Kendskab til branchen – og en uddannelse som lastvognsmekaniker, landbrugsmaskinmekaniker eller lignende.
  • Du er alsidig, idet arbejdsopgaverne ligger indenfor flere områder.
  • Det er en fordel - men ikke et krav, at du har god erfaring med svejsning, el, hydraulik eller pneumatik.
  • Du er indstillet på en varieret og travl hverdag og kan håndtere flere bolde i luften på en gang.
  • Du er uddannelsesparat og ønsker fortsat en udvikling indenfor branchen.
Vi tilbyder
  • Ansættelse i en virksomhed med en god og sund økonomi samt gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold.
  • Vi tilbyder gode personalevilkår, herunder sundhedssikring og pensionsordning
  • Et spændende job med mange udfordringer, hvor du selv kan præge din arbejdsdag.
  • Udviklingsmulighed i takt med din kompetence og interesse via efteruddannelse ved Volvo og Renault.
  • Gode arbejdskollegaer og et godt kollegialt sammenhold.
Din arbejdstid ud Vi har skiftende arbejdstider, herunder aften- og lørdagsvagter, som du bliver en del af efter en fast rotationsplan. Er det dig, vi mangler? Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Ring til værkstedschef Dennis Heldt på telefon 8827 9399 og høre mere om jobbet. Du er også velkommen til at kigge forbi til en uforpligtende snak, en kop kaffe og en rundvisning på værkstedet: Skifter Lastbil A/S, Industrisvinget 10, 6330 Padborg.
  • Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale
  • Ansøgning: Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så ræk ud til os allerede i dag.
Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Lastenhoitaja lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun
jobs.description: Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle lapsiperheiden kotipalvelun pariin?Tällä hetkellä haemme aktiivisia keikkalaisia tuomaan vahvistusta keikkaluontoisesti työskentelevien tiimiimme. Haussa voidaan huomioida vain hakijat, joilla on vähintään sosiaali-, terveys-, tai kasvatusalan ammatillinen perustutkinto tai aikaisempi kouluasteen tutkinto.Tehtävänäsi on tukea eri elämäntilanteissa olevia perheitä ja edistää perheiden arjessa selviytymistä keskittyen ensisijaisesti lapsen hoitoon. Työnkuvaan voi kuulua myös kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, kokonaisuutta määrittelee asiakkaan ja perheen tarve. Käynnit ovat yleensä 3-5h mittaisia ja arkipäivien lisäksi käyntejä on myös illalla sekä viikonloppuisin. Asiakassuhteet ovat pääosin pitkäaikaisia, joten tiedämme, kuinka tärkeää on, että hoitajan ja asiakkaan kemiat kohtaavat.Me teemme työtä aina asiakkaan hyvinvointi edellä ja olemmekin siinä melkoisen hyviä: sisäpiirissä olevat sanoisivat, että pykälää parempia!Lupaammekin sinulle:\-mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen\-työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi\-lähiesihenkilön tuen\-pitkäaikaisen työn ja vakaan työpaikan\-monipuolisen työnkuvan\-työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan\-palkkaluokka on G20C (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)Sinä: Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, kenelle asiakkaan ja perheen hyvinvointi tulee ykkösenä. Aiempi kokemus lasten ja perheiden parissa tehdystä työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista. Tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote, koska työ sisältää lasten kanssa työskentelyä.Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa! Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. jobs.title: Køkkenmedarbejder til daginstitution på Amager
jobs.description:
Køkkenmedarbejder til daginstitution på Amager

Den integreret institution Sundby Asyl søger en engageret og faglig velfunderet køkkenmedarbejder 27½-30 timer ugentligt. Sundby Asyl huser ca. 44 børn i alderen 0-6 år. Vi er en stabil personalegruppe der mangler en køkkenmedarbejder til at lave mad til børn og personale, og til i øvrigt at drive køkkenet.

Vi holder til i et charmerende hus, tæt på Amagerbro metrostation. Børnene er fordelt på en vuggestuegruppe, en småbørnsgruppe og en børnehavegruppe. Vores hyggelige hus er fordelt på tre niveauer, hvor køkkenet er placeret centralt på husets mellemniveau.

Københavns Kommune har udarbejdet en ambitiøs mad- og måltidsstrategi for kommunens børn, som vi følger.  Dette indeholder krav om økologisk guldmærke, arbejde med klimamål, reducering af madspild, samt tilberedning af klimavenlige og sunde måltider, med udgangspunkt i sæsonens råvare.  

Der serveres morgenmad, formiddagsmad, frokost og eftermiddagsmad til alle børn og voksne i huset. Det er ikke et krav, men bestemt en fordel, hvis du før har lavet mad til børn.

Du har sandsynligvis en køkkenfaglig-og/eller ernæringsuddannelse, og/eller arbejder du ud fra principper om at være eksperimenterende, nysgerrig og modig på smag, farver og sanser.

Fordi du skal arbejde selvstændigt, er det vigtigt, at du er engageret og har interesse for madlavningen, og selv kan sammensætte og planlægge ernæringsrigtige menuer af høj kulinarisk kvalitet, efter fødevarestyrelsens anbefalinger, til børn i alderen 0-6 år.

Du skal udarbejde og publicere madplaner på Aula, samt sørge for varebestilling og modtagelse af vare.

Du er kreativ i et køkken, og laver gerne tingene fra bunden, tager tingene med et smil, og har overskud til børnene og dine kollegaer, også når der er travlt. Ligeledes skal du selvstændig sikre hygiejnestandarden opfylder myndighedernes krav og dagligt udføre egenkontrol. Det er køkkenmedarbejderen der gør rent og rydder op i køkkenet. Du får med andre ord, ansvar for hele køkkenet, og stor mulighed for at præge hverdagen.

I særligt aftalte opgaver omkring traditioner, som jul, påske, fastelavn mm. forventes det at kunne hjælpe udover den faste arbejdstid ved behov.

Mad er pædagogik

Vi ønsker at børnene skal have en bevidsthed om hvad de kommer i munden, og hvor det kommer fra. Maden skal være med til at sikre at børnenes mad mod bliver udfordret og styrket. Stuer og køkken samarbejder i huset om at inddrage børnene i forskellige processer omkring måltiderne. I Sundby Asyl har vi en madpædagog som understøtter dette arbejde.

Yderligere information

Jobbet er en fast stilling på 27½-30 timer om ugen og arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 8-13.30/14 på alle hverdage. Jobbet er ledigt pr. 1.2.27. Løn efter gældende overenskomst.

Ønsker du at besøge vores dejlige hus eller vide mere om stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores leder Pia på tlf. 25432276. Yderligere oplysninger om Sundby Asyl kan du få på vores hjemmeside www.sundbyasyl.dk

Ansøgningen sendes senest d. 9/11-26 til mail ansoegning@sundbyasyl.dk I ansøgningen bedes du vedhæfte cv, samt et menuforslag til en uge.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne og straffeattest, samt tager referencer.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland
