jobs.title: Service Manager Zinkgruvan
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Servicechef till Zinkgruvan Är du en trygg, närvarande och coachande ledare som trivs med att leda en etablerad verksamhet? Vi söker nu en Servicechef till vår serviceverksamhet i Zinkgruvan – en roll för dig som vill förvalta, skapa stabilitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både medarbetare och kund. Här blir du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten, nära både människor och maskiner, i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och kontinuitet är avgörande. Ditt uppdrag Som Servicechef i Zinkgruvan har du det övergripande ansvaret för den lokala serviceverksamheten. Du leder och planerar arbetet för servicetekniker, administrativ/lagerfunktion samt supervisor och säkerställer att verksamheten fungerar stabilt och effektivt över tid. Rollen är operativ och närvarande, med stor del av arbetet kopplat till den dagliga driften och kundkontakten. Fokus ligger på att förvalta befintliga arbetssätt, säkerställa god leverans och skapa en trygg och välfungerande arbetsmiljö. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden: •    Planera, leda och fördela arbetet i den lokala personalstyrkan.•    Vara en närvarande chef som stöttar, coachar och skapar struktur i vardagen.•    Säkerställa ett gott säkerhets-, arbetsmiljö- och förebyggande arbete.•    Vara kundens primära kontakt och bygga långsiktiga relationer.•    Ansvara för serviceverkstad, administration och lagerverksamhet.•    Ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten, inklusive budget, uppföljning och rapportering.•    Beräkna och lämna offerter vid behov.•    Arbeta för god samverkan med försäljningsorganisationen.•    Bibehålla och utveckla befintliga serviceavtal samt stötta lokal marknadsföring. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar. Är du den vi söker? Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av ledarskap från arbetsledande- eller chefsroller och har en god förståelse för vad som krävs för att driva en välfungerande serviceverksamhet. Du är praktisk, strukturerad och bekväm med att ta ansvar för både människor och resultat. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha: •    Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap med arbetsledande- och/eller personalansvar.•    Teknisk bakgrund eller starkt tekniskt intresse.•    Grundläggande kunskaper inom ekonomi, uppföljning och rapportering.•    God datorvana och erfarenhet av affärs-/ERP-system (gärna SAP).•    God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.•    B-körkort. Placering och resor Denna tjänst är placerad i Zinkgruvan. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten. Ansökan och kontaktinformation Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 10 november. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Developer
jobs.description: Volvo Construction Equipment Technology – Eskilstuna Come join us in developing the next-generation software platform for Volvo Construction Equipment's machine ECUs! About the RoleAs an Embedded Developer, you will work at the very heart of our machines. You will design, implement, and verify hardware-centric real-time software for our proprietary ECUs (Electronic Control Units). Functional Safety is an integral part of our development, and we combine rigorous engineering practices with modern software design.You will join an agile team that values clean code, modern toolchains, and technical excellence. As we develop our next-generation software platform, you will have the opportunity to influence its architecture, technical direction, and engineering practices.We value engineers who take ownership, challenge existing solutions, and contribute to sound technical decisions. The scope of your responsibilities and technical ownership will reflect your experience and strengths, with opportunities to grow and take on greater responsibility over time.Your Main Responsibilities    Design and development of embedded real-time software using Modern C++20, targeting RTOS and bare-metal environments.    Contributing to software architecture and technical solutions, balancing performance, maintainability, and real-time constraints.    Developing software in accordance with Functional Safety requirements, including standards such as ISO 13849 (PLd) and IEC 61508.    Developing and maintaining a modern, deterministic build environment based on CMake.    Ensuring software quality through static analysis, unit testing, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, including high test coverage requirements such as MC/DC.Who Are You?We are looking for an engineer who is passionate about embedded systems and enjoys solving complex technical challenges at the intersection of software and hardware. We particularly value engineers who bring deep technical expertise, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to influence technical solutions. At the same time, we recognize that strong engineering talent comes with different levels of experience, and we welcome candidates with a solid technical foundation and the potential to grow. What matters most is your technical curiosity, problem-solving ability, and commitment to building high-quality software. What You Bring    A solid foundation in C++ programming, gained through professional experience, education, or substantial technical projects.    Understanding of software engineering principles and an interest in embedded systems, real-time constraints, and microcontrollers.    Experience using Python for scripting, automation, testing, or software development.    The ability to analyze technical problems, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with others.    Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is a plus. Experience We Particularly Value    Embedded real-time software development using RTOS or bare-metal architectures, including memory management and deterministic execution.    Modern C++ design, including C++20 and modern design principles.    Communication networks and diagnostic protocols such as CAN / CAN FD, J1939, and UDS (ISO 14229).    Functional Safety development according to standards such as ISO 13849, ISO 26262, or IEC 61508.    Development tooling involving CMake, XML-based configurations, code generation, and Python-based automation.    Software verification using static analysis, unit testing, HIL, and structural code coverage.    Experience making architectural decisions, driving technical improvements, or guiding other developers.You don't need to have experience in all these areas. We are interested in the expertise you bring, your ability to solve challenging problems, and your motivation to develop further.Additional Merits    Model-based design or control theory, such as filters and regulators.    Configuration and setup of traceable build environments using CMake Presets.    Experience with safety-critical hardware features, such as memory protection units (MPU/XRDC) or hardware diagnostics. What We Value    Pragmatism over dogma. Solutions should work in real-life contexts.    Collaboration and dialogue over top-down control. The best solutions come from combining different perspectives and experiences.    Technical ownership and sound engineering judgment. We value people who take responsibility and think beyond their immediate tasks.    Continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing. We grow stronger by developing both our technology and each other.With us, you will get:    Real influence on our next-generation software platform, with opportunities to shape architecture, make important technical decisions, and establish engineering practices that will influence Volvo CE's software development for years to come.    A technically advanced environment working with modern C++20, safety-critical systems, real-time software, and modern development and verification tools.    Long-term technical ownership, developing and evolving software that serves multiple machine platforms and product generations.    End-to-end involvement, from architecture and implementation to testing and validation on real hardware and machines.    A collaborative engineering culture where technical expertise, open dialogue, and knowledge sharing are highly valued.    The opportunity to work with skilled colleagues and domain experts in embedded systems, functional safety, control systems, and machine applications.    Opportunities to continuously develop your skills, explore new technologies, and contribute to improving our ways of working.    A healthy work-life balance with flexible ways of working and a sustainable pace.    A stable and long-term employer with a clear focus on technology, innovation, and sustainable development.    The satisfaction of seeing your software move tons of steel, enabling safer, smarter, and more sustainable construction equipment used around the world. Last day to apply: 3 NovemberFor questions about the position, please contact: Johan Lokrantz, Head of Embedded Software Location: Eskilstuna, Headquarters, Technology CenterAs part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. We look forward to receiving your application!We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Är du den vi söker?Arbetsplatsen kommer att vara kombinerad mellan vuxenkorttiden och boendestödet. Vid korttidsboendet bor vuxna personer växelvis utifrån biståndsbedömda beslut. Tjänstgöring sker företrädesvis dag, kväll och helg men det kan också förekomma pass dygnets alla timmar, på ett rullande schema (dag, kväll, journatt och helg) Boendestödet arbetar utifrån biståndsbedömda beslut enl SoL företrädesvis och arbetar enl schema dag, kväll och helg och utgår i arbetet med klient från klientens hemmiljö.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERVid vuxenkorttiden kommer du att vara kontaktman för de brukare som är beviljade insatsen samt ha ett administrativt och praktiskt ansvar för verksamheten. Insatsen korttidsboende är avsedd för miljöombyte, rehabilitering eller avlastning för anhöriga för brukare. Insatsen kan ges enl SoLeller LSS. Insatsen boendestöd är en beviljad insats enl SoL för personer med psykisk, neuropsykiatrisk eller begåvningsmässig funktionsnedsättning som behöver hjälp i vardagen för att leva ett självständigt liv. Stödet är individanpassat och syftar till att träna färdigheter, skapa struktur i hemmet, hantera ekonomi och främja sociala kontakter.  I rollen som stödassistent upprättar du och följer genomförandeplaner och stöttar individen i sin vardag utifrån behov, självbestämmande, delaktighet och styrande dokument. Du genomför uppföljningar tillsammans med individen för att förmågor ska utvecklas eller bibehållas. Du samverkar med övriga stödassistenter, enhetschef, sjuksköterska, fysio- och arbetsterapeut, anhöriga och andra i individens nätverk för att utveckla och stötta individen, verksamheten och arbetet kring individen. För att trivas i rollen som stödassistent hos oss ska du vara självständig, driven, flexibel och ha god förmåga till samarbete.  Tjänsten kräver god självkännedom och att du är lugn och trygg i dig själv samt innehar god empatisk förmåga. Vi vill att du har ett genuint intresse för människor och att du tycker om att arbeta med människor som har olika förmågor och behov. Du ska utifrån individens dagsform kunna anpassa stödet utifrån det. Du behöver vara flexibel gällande schema och tycka att förändringsarbete är roligt.KVALIFIKATIONERDu är utbildad undersköterska, stödassistent med inriktning pedagogik eller social/behandlingspedagog. Vi ser gärna att du är utbildad i metoden Ett självständigt liv (ESL) och motiverande samtal (MI). Du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat och mött människor i olika utsatta situationer. Du har kunskap om / kännedom om olika psykiatriska och neuropsykiatriska diagnoser, psykisk ohälsa, våld i nära relation samt skadligt bruk och beroende. Du är bekväm med att använda digitala verktyg som dator och smartphone. Du ska kunna hantera det svenska språket på ett nyanserat sätt, i tal och skrift samt inneha B-körkort och körvana.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.Arbetstid: Schema.Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt personuppgiftslagen.Inför anställningen kommer du att behöva uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret. OBS: Skicka INTE din ansökan via E-post eller brev.Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development!At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products!We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund.System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future teamWe who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop.We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What you'll do here as a mechanical engineerAs a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you?We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products!In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply):     Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo.    Prototype creation    Mechanical engineering background    Windchill/Creo knowledge    Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal    Design for production    Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you?A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. Therefore, we offer fantastic benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday coffee, company bonus, health insurance, paid vacation, generous parental leave, generous sick/accident insurance, and your very own Axis bike - just to mention a few. What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis  Ready to act?If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Maiko Karlsson at phone number 046-272 1800.We review applications continuously, so don't wait to send in your application!

jobs.title: Butikssäljare till OKQ8 Sörböle, behovsanställning
jobs.description: OK Västerbotten är en lokal förening som underlättar för människor i rörelse och verkar för ett hållbart och levande län. Vi ägs av våra västerbottniska medlemmar och drivs på demokratisk grund. Vi är idag över 90 000 medlemmar och driver 34 drivmedelsstationer runt om i Västerbotten, där 21 är bemannade. Samtliga stationer arbetar under varumärket OKQ8. Vi är ett lokalt, nytänkande och hållbart alternativ – för dig och oss, för samhället och miljön. Vi vill att hela vårt län ska leva – för då kan vi fortsätta spela viktig roll för Västerbotten, för orterna där vi finns och för människorna som bor och färdas här. Som medarbetare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vår folkrörelse för ett levande län.Är du en serviceinriktad lagspelare? I så fall kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt arbete i en spännande miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik, med stor variation på arbetsuppgifterna. Ena sekunden hyr du ut ett släp för att snabbt skifta till att servera mat. På våra stationer är det ofta ett högt tempo där du och dina kollegor tar hand om våra kunder och deras önskemål.Vi sökerDu är en positiv person som gillar att träffa nya människor. Du tycker om att arbeta i högt tempo och ser fram emot att vara en del av ett sammansvetsat team som tillsammans löser det arbetsdagen har att bjuda på. Som säljare på en OKQ8-station är du företagets yttersta representant och vi förväntar oss att du ser varje kundmöte som början på en långvarig relation. Det är meriterande om du tidigare har jobbat med service eller försäljning. B-körkort är ett formellt krav.Vi erbjuderPå våra stationer erbjuder vi en spännande arbetsplats, med rolig atmosfär och härliga kollegor. Här arbetar människor i alla åldrar med olika bakgrund. Vi tror på utveckling av oss själva och jobbar tillsammans som ett team för att nå uppsatta mål. Hos oss har du möjlighet att bli en framgångsrik säljare som har roligt på arbetet.Som Butikssäljare arbetar du skifttjänstgöring. Denna tjänst är en behovsanställning. Stationen har öppet vardagar mellan klockan 06:00 - 00:00 och helger mellan klockan 08:00 - 00:00.Kan du göra oss ännu bättre? Sök då tjänsten redan idag!OK Västerbotten arbetar för att vara en jämställd arbetsplats med medarbetare som trivs och utvecklas och där olikheter uppmuntras. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som hjälper till att minska utanförskap och bidrar till mångfald.Våra medarbetare är vår viktigaste tillgång och en förutsättning för att vi ska nå framgång som företag. Här kan du ta del av vad vi erbjuder som arbetsgivare, både för att attrahera och behålla medarbetare.    Varierande arbete som gör skillnad - Varje dag på din station bjuder på omväxlande arbetsuppgifter och erfarenheter. Du är inte bara proffs på service och en problemlösare, du förbereder och serverar mat och hjälper till med enklare bilvård vilket ger dig en bredd av kompetenser. Under arbetsdagarna varvas högt tempo med lugnare stunder. Att jobba på en station i Västerbotten innebär att du är med och underlättar för människor i rörelse och verkar för ett hållbart och levande län.    Spännande möten med människor - Stationsmedarbetare är ett socialt yrke där du träffar nya människor varje dag. Och genom vänlig service och professionell attityd gör du stor skillnad för våra kunders upplevelse av OKQ8.    Team som skapar framgång - Tillsammans med dina kollegor är du en del av det kompetenta team som möter våra kunder varje dag. Med hög arbetsmoral som innebär att vara proaktiv, hugga i där det behövs och göra det lilla extra skapar ni gemensamt stationens framgång – och har roligt under tiden. Hos oss är det inte ovanligt att medarbetare blir vänner för livet.    Utveckling och karriär - När vi anställer medarbetare investerar vi även i dig som person. Din bakgrund är inte det viktigaste – däremot din inställning och vilja att göra ett bra arbete. För dig som vill ta ytterligare ett steg i karriären erbjuder vi fina möjligheter, flera av våra stationschefer började som stationsmedarbetare. Genom arbetets alla utmaningar utvecklas du inte bara i ditt arbete – utan även som människa.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.What you'll doOur infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:    Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.    Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.    Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.    Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.    Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.    Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.    Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.    You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.What we're looking for    You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.    You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.    You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.    You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.    You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.    You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.    University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.Tech stackCloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKSIaC - TerraformCI/CD - GitHub ActionsLanguages - Python, TypeScriptAI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)What we offer    Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.    Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.    Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.    Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.    AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.    Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details    Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.    Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.    Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.    Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.    Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.    Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technologyWe handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

jobs.title: Natteravn med truckcertifikat? Så har vi jobbet til dig!
jobs.description:
Vi søger 3 operatører til natholdet

Medarbejderne ApS søger på vegne af en mellemstor produktionsvirksomhed beliggende mellem Viborg og Silkeborg 3 operatører til nathold.

Virksomheden producerer mineralblandinger til landbruget og lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, præcision og et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og en positiv omgangstone er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af produktionen, hvor dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Udtapning og påfyldning af produkter i bigbags.

  • Truckkørsel i forbindelse med håndtering og flytning af produkter.

  • Aflæsning og efterfølgelse af produktionsopskrifter.

  • Korrekt dosering af de forskellige ingredienser og mineralblandinger.

  • Korrekt mærkning af de færdige produkter.

  • Oprydning og rengøring af arbejdsområdet efter endt skift, så produktionen er klar til dagholdet.

Det er vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt, da korrekt dosering og mærkning har stor betydning for produktets kvalitet.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har et gyldigt truckcertifikat – det er et krav.

  • Taler, læser og forstår dansk, så du kan læse, forstå og følge produktionsopskrifter og arbejdsinstruktioner.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, kvalitetsbevidst og omhyggelig i dit arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig trives med at være en del af et team.

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde og en god omgangstone.

  • Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og på at holde orden omkring dig.

Erfaring fra produktion er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at gøre en god indsats.

Hvad kan du se frem til?

Du bliver en del af en mellemstor virksomhed med en god arbejdskultur, hvor man hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og bidrager til et godt fællesskab. Her er det vigtigt, at alle gør deres bedste, passer ind i teamet og er med til at sikre en god tone i hverdagen.

Arbejdstid

Du arbejder på nathold fra søndag nat til fredag nat.

Opstart

Vi ønsker opstart snarest muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Har du truckcertifikat, trives du med natarbejde, og er du klar til at blive en del af et godt team? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet rekruttering og vikarbureau med over 20 års erfaring. Vi har kontorer 9 forskellige i landet. Vi er medlem af VikarBranchen i DI, hvilket forpligtiger os til at overheolde et sæt regler. Du er i gode hænder hos os.

jobs.title: Teamleder til kørselsafdeling
jobs.description:
Teamleder til kørselsafdelingen - skab struktur, fremdrift og stærke leverancer Har du blik for både mennesker, logistik og den gode drift? Trives du med at skabe struktur i en hverdag, hvor planer kan ændre sig hurtigt- og motiveres du af at få medarbejdere, biler og leverancer til at spille sammen? Hos Idealcombi søger vi nu en handlekraftig og struktureret teamleder til vores kørselsafdeling, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige ledelse og sikre en effektiv kørselsplanlægning til vores kunder i Danmark og på eksportmarkederne. Om stillingen Som teamleder får du det daglige ansvar for kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører. Du bliver en central del af den daglige drift og får ansvaret for at sikre, at vores leverancer planlægges og gennemføres effektivt, og at kunderne får den rette information undervejs. Du er tæt på medarbejderne og den operationelle hverdag og skal kunne bevare overblikket, prioritere og træffe beslutninger, når virkeligheden ændrer sig. Samtidig får du en lederopgave, hvor du gennem løbende dialog, opfølgning og udvikling sikrer et velfungerende og motiveret team. Kørselsafdelingen har en stor kontaktflade på tværs af Idealcombi, og du kommer særligt til at samarbejde med produktion, salg og øvrige interne funktioner. Derfor er det afgørende, at du kommunikerer tydeligt og formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer, både internt og eksternt. Dine primære ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:
  • Planlægning og koordinering af kørsel for både Danmark og eksport
  • Sikre leveringsadvisering til kunder og opfølgning på restordrer
  • Daglig ledelse og udvikling af medarbejderne i kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører
  • Sikre god koordinering og kommunikation med kunder, chauffører og interne samarbejdspartnere
Du bliver også ansvarlig for, at vores ledelsessystem og relevante personalepolitikker efterleves i afdelingen, og at teamet løbende har de rette kompetencer til at løse opgaverne. Din profil Du er en synlig leder, der trives tæt på driften og medarbejderne. Du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har gennemslagskraft, når der skal prioriteres og træffes beslutninger. Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have mange års formel ledererfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har forståelse for transport, logistik eller kørselsplanlægning og samtidig har lysten og evnen til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og drift. Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med kørselsplanlægning, transport, logistik eller disponering
  • Gerne har en relevant baggrund som fx kørselsdisponent, speditør eller lignende
  • Har ledererfaring, eller er klar til at tage næste skridt ind i en lederrolle
  • Arbejder systematisk og struktureret og er stærk i din opfølgning
  • Har gennemslagskraft og bevarer overblikket i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag
  • Er god til at kommunikere og skabe relationer på tværs af organisationen
  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer og er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer
  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk i skrift og tale
Vi tilbyder Hos Idealcombi får du en central rolle i en funktion, der har stor betydning for både vores kunder og den daglige drift. Du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på kørselsafdelingen og være med til løbende at udvikle både medarbejdere, arbejdsgange og samarbejdet på tværs af virksomheden. Vi tilbyder blandt andet:
  • En selvstændig lederrolle med ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel
  • En varieret hverdag, hvor drift, ledelse, planlægning og problemløsning går hånd i hånd
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og ordentlighed vægtes højt
  • En lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, inkl. pension og sundhedsordning
Kontakt og ansøgning Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabrikschef Allan Sørensen på tlf. 96 88 24 85 eller mail als@idealcombi.dk. Send din ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt. Ansøgninger behandles løbende og fortroligt, og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Ansøgningsfristen er den 08-11-2026. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. Om Idealcombi Idealcombi har, siden det første vindue blev fremstillet i 1973, haft domicil i Thy. Hovedsædet i Hurup rummer i dag 100.000 m² til produktion og administration med mere end 400 ansatte. Herfra har Idealcombi gennem mere end 50 år fremstillet vinduer og yderdøre i høj kvalitet. Innovation er et grundlæggende omdrejningspunkt i virksomheden, og vi arbejder kontinuerligt og målrettet på at være blandt de førende inden for udviklingen af vinduer og døre til nutidens og fremtidens behov. Design, funktion, energiforbrug og en optimal miljøvenlig produktion er blandt de væsentligste parametre - og vores medarbejderes kompetencer er afgørende for, at vi lykkes.

Like ved Saga Trollheimen Hotel flyter elva Rinna. Den har alltid spilt en viktig rolle i området, og Rindal fikk navnet sitt etter elva. Aktiviteten var stor, og sagbruket var et naturlig sentrum for virksomheten. Senere kjøpte Emil Gåsvand, Mortens far, sagbruket. I 1987 brant sagbruket ned til grunnen. Nye tider gjorde det uaktuelt å bygge sagbruket opp igjen. Det var da Morten fikk ideen om å bruke tomta til å bygge et "sagarike" - en gjenskapelse av gamle dagers bygdeliv. I 1991 sto første del klar i form av regionens første håndlaftede nordmørslån (våningshus) på over 100 år. Den nybygde låna fikk navnet Saga Skysstasjon. Den vakte stor interesse og fikk blant annet byggeskikkprisen for 1994. Morten så snart potensialet i å bygge et turistanlegg med norsk kultur og historie som tema. I samarbeid med bedriften

jobs.title: Teknisk projektsælger / beregner til Eftex / Joris Ide
jobs.description:
Har du en byggeteknisk baggrund, et godt blik for løsninger og lyst til at kombinere teknik, rådgivning og salg? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Eftex / Joris Ide er i positiv udvikling og vi søger derfor en engageret og selvstændig teknisk projektsælger/beregner, som får en central rolle i vores daglige arbejde med projekter, kunder og tekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en vigtig del af processen, fra de første tegninger og projektmateriale til den færdige løsning. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kunder, rådgivere, entreprenører, samarbejdspartnere og kolleger og får gode muligheder for selv at præge din hverdag og udvikle rollen.

En del af vores samarbejde foregår på tværs af landegrænser og du vil derfor også få en international kontaktflade, hvor noget af kommunikationen vil foregå på engelsk.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Projektering og mængdeberegning på baggrund af byggeteknisk materiale

  • Teknisk rådgivning af kunder og samarbejdspartnere om produktvalg og montage

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og kalkulationer

  • Ordrebehandling og opfølgning på projekter

  • Dialog med kunder, rådgivere, entreprenører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • Bidrage til at finde den rigtige tekniske og kommercielle løsning til det enkelte projekt

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere i både Danmark og udlandet

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Vi sørger for en grundig introduktion til vores produkter, løsninger og arbejdsprocesser, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaven.

Stillingen vil hurtigt give dig en central position i organisationen. Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og vil opleve, at dine beslutninger og din faglighed gør en konkret forskel, for både kunderne og virksomheden.

Vi har korte beslutningsveje og der er plads til selv at tage initiativ, komme med idéer og være med til at udvikle både løsninger og arbejdsmetoder.

Samtidig bliver du en del af Joris Ide, som giver adgang til en international organisation, stærke produkter og kompetencer, samt et bredt netværk af kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af Europa.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har en byggeteknisk uddannelse eller erfaring – eksempelvis som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker, teknisk designer/tegner

  • Har god forståelse for byggeri, konstruktioner og tekniske tegninger

  • Har erfaring med projektering, beregning eller teknisk salg – gerne fra byggebranchen

  • Er fortrolig med Microsoft Office og gerne AutoCAD

  • Arbejder struktureret, med sans for detaljer

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og følge opgaver helt til dørs

  • Har lyst til kundekontakt og trives med at finde gode løsninger i dialog med andre

  • Er serviceminded, professionel og god til at samarbejde

  • Har lyst til at kommunikere på engelsk, når samarbejdet med vores internationale kolleger kræver det

Det vigtigste for os er dog ikke din titel eller præcis hvilken uddannelse, du kommer med. Har du den rette byggetekniske forståelse, nysgerrighed og lyst til at lære, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Hvem er Eftex / Joris Ide?

Eftex er en veletableret virksomhed med omkring 30 års erfaring i byggebranchen. Vi udvikler, importerer og sælger tekniske løsninger til byggeriet og har specialiseret os i blandt andet løsninger til støbte etageadskillelser i beton, stål-/kompositløsninger og lyddæmpning.

Eftex er en del af Joris Ide, en international virksomhed med stærke kompetencer inden for stål og byggeløsninger. Joris Ide har aktiviteter i mere end 15 lande og mere end 2.700 medarbejdere. Det internationale samarbejde giver os adgang til et stærkt produktprogram, faglig viden og kompetencer på tværs af landegrænser.

For dig betyder det, at du får det bedste fra to verdener: en lokal virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje og stor mulighed for indflydelse – kombineret med styrken og mulighederne i en international organisation.

Vi holder til i HI-Park i Hammerum ved Herning, hvor vi har både kontor og lager.

Hos Eftex bliver du en del af et team af kompetente og engagerede kolleger, hvor vi lægger vægt på både faglighed, ansvar og et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af en virksomhed i positiv udvikling, hvor du får ansvar, kundekontakt og mulighed for at bruge din byggetekniske faglighed i praksis, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller kunne du bare tænke dig at høre lidt mere om Eftex / Joris Ide og jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Henrik eller Klaus for en uforpligtende samtale.

Du er også meget velkommen til at tage kontakt, hvis du er nysgerrig på stillingen, men er i tvivl om, hvorvidt din baggrund passer præcis til det, vi søger.Du kan kontakte CEO Henrik Christensen 24 44 05 57Eller Klaus Andersen 42 16 04 70

Send din ansøgning og CV til Eftex / Joris Ide.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Partner Manager (B2B Sales) | UK
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

Excited about this role?

We’d love to hear from you. Please apply via our career portal with your CV and cover letter.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Work location: Oslo, Norway (Hybrid)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

jobs.title: Driftsavtale fysioterapi 100 % - Sarpsborg kommune
jobs.description:
Sarpsborg kommune har ledig avtalehjemmel med 100 % kommunalt driftstilskudd, for offentlig godkjent fysioterapeut fra 01.01.2027. Den ledige driftsavtalen er del av gruppepraksis ved Framklinikken AS, lokalisert i Iseveien senter, Borgenhaugen. Instituttet har totalt 200 % avtalehjemler, samt 2 helprivate fysioterapeuter og 1 osteopat.  Klinikken ble etablert i 2005. Behandlere har tilgang til lukkede behandlingsrom og samarbeid med tilknyttet treningssenter med gode utstyrsfasiliteter som gir mulighet for aktiv tilnærming.   Kommunens fysioterapitjeneste består av både kommunalt ansatte fysioterapeuter og fysioterapeuter med driftsavtaler. Tjenesten er administrert under kommuneområde Velferd. Kommunen har 26 driftsavtaler og 16,6 stillinger for kommunalt ansatte fysioterapeuter, samt 6 barnefysioterapeuter som er tilknyttet familiesentrene.  Tildeling og overdragelse vil skje iht. rammeavtalen for avtalefysioterapeuter, ASA 4313. Praksis skal drives i henhold til relevant helselovgivning og på de vilkår som fremgår av forskrift om funksjons- og kvalitetskrav for fysioterapeuter med kommunal driftsavtale, samt ASA 4313, slik den til enhver tid lyder.     Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen er knyttet til pasientrettet arbeid innen allmenn fysioterapi på instituttet, og ved behov i pasientens hjem. 

Om lag 20 % av stillingen vil være knyttet til oppfølging av voksne personer med medfødt eller tidlig ervervet funksjonsnedsettelse innen fagområdet voksenhabilitering. Dette inkluderer oppfølging av pasienter i hjem/bolig, og samarbeid med arenaer pasientene er tilknyttet.  Stillingen gir en spennende mulighet til å kombinere bred fysioterapipraksis med spesialisert oppfølging av en pasientgruppe med sammensatte behov. Det forventes en kunnskapsbasert og oppdatert tilnærming til undersøkelse, vurdering, behandling og rehabilitering.  Det forventes at fysioterapeut følger vedtatt prioriteringsnøkkel for Sarpsborg kommune, og har en aktiv tilnærming for å gjøre pasientene i stand til å mestre egen helse. Praksis skal ha et åpent behandlingstilbud til befolkningen, med fokus på effektive pasientforløp for å redusere lange ventelister. Fysioterapeut skal samarbeide tett med andre instanser og bidra til å utvikle instituttets tilbud til kommunens innbyggere. Det forventes at fysioterapeuten ønsker å bidra aktivt ved instituttet, både faglig og sosialt. Det forventes at en stor del av behandlingen gis som gruppebehandling. Kommunen forventer at man deltar på felles fagmøter og leverer driftsrapport årlig. Dokumentasjon skal utføres i godkjent journalsystem.   

Kvalifikasjoner

Krav til utdanning :

  • Autorisert (offentlig godkjent) fysioterapeut.

Relevant videreutdanning/master vil kunne vektlegges. Kandidaten må ha:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som fysioterapeut.  HPR nummer skal oppgis 
  • Bred og relevant klinisk erfaring og kompetanse innen allmenn fysioterapi
  • Formell og oppdatert kompetanse innen allmennfysioterapi, med vektlegging av kompetanse innen ortopediske lidelser.   
  • Erfaring med eller interesse for fysioterapi til personer med medfødt eller tidlig ervervet funksjonsnedsettelse innen fagområdet voksenhabilitering
  • Erfaring og interesse for å organisere behandling av pasienter i grupper. 
  • Innsikt i inntaks- og prioriteringsarbeid, ventelister og ventelistereduserende tiltak
  • Evne til å drive fysioterapipraksis med avtalehjemmel
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid om pasienter
  • God kjennskap til ASA4313, og innholdet i denne

Gode skriftlige og muntlige norske språkferdigheter tilsvarende B2   Det er ønskelig at kandidaten har:    God innsikt i fysioterapeutens rolle og ansvarsområder  Et stort initiativ og engasjement for å skape og forme en god praksis.  Har god kjennskap til IKT-verktøy, journalsystem og elektronisk samhandling.  Det forventes at aktuelle søkere er kjent med nasjonale politiske føringer for fremtidens kommunehelsetjeneste. Det er viktig å gjøre seg kjent med og holde seg oppdatert på gjeldende føringer for Velferd og helsetjenester i Sarpsborg kommune. I tråd med dette legges det vekt på evne til å være med på å utvikle gode fysioterapitjenester for befolkningen i tråd med kommunens fremtidige behov.  

Personlige egenskaper

Søker må ha stor arbeidskapasitet, være faglig engasjert og motivert for kontinuerlig faglig oppdatering og utvikling. Søker må være strukturert, effektiv, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst, samt ha gode samarbeids og kommunikasjonsevner. Søker må ha evne til å reflektere rundt egen rolle, samhandling, pasientforløp og ansvarsområder. Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt ved vurdering av kandidater I søknaden forventes det at du gjør godt rede for samlet erfaring og kompetanse innen allmenn fysioterapi, dine faglige interesseområder og planer for fortsatt faglig utvikling.   

Vi tilbyr

Viktig å vite før du starter hos oss: Som fysioterapeut med driftsavtale i Sarpsborg kommune bidrar du til å løse viktige samfunnsoppdrag gjennom verdiene våre; framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig (FÅRT) Du har ansvaret for tjenester som er helt sentrale i hverdagen til våre innbyggere. En stor kommune som Sarpsborg tilbyr solide fagmiljøer, fokus på innovasjon og utvikling. Som fysioterapeut i kommunen disponerer du en avtalehjemmel på de vilkår, rettigheter og plikter som følger av avtaler, reglementer og lover.  Driftsavtalen tildeles av Sarpsborg kommune som enkeltvedtak etter forvaltningsloven.   Du må sende søknaden din elektronisk innen fristen via Webcruiter. Relevante kursbevis, attester og vitnemål må lastes opp.   Politiattest :Før du tiltrer må du legge frem politiattest uten merknader som har betydning for arbeidsforhold iht. helse og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 .   

KontaktinformasjonGrethe Lillian Strekerud Larsen, Seniorrådgiver, 47482014, grethe-strekerud.larsen@sarpsborg.com Helene Jacobsen, Avdelingsleder , 92034443, helene.jacobsen@sarpsborg.com ArbeidsstedSnekkerstubakken 26 1738 Borgenhaugen Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Sarpsborg kommune Referansenr.: 5192712467 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 11.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi Sarpsborg! Det er vår visjon, og sammen jobber vi hver dag for at våre innbyggere skal ha gode dager. For å klare dette, trenger vi dyktige medarbeidere. 

Her i Sarpsborg kommune jobber vi etter verdiene framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig. For å levere gode tjenester og skape gode arbeidsmiljøer skal alle ansatte vise handling gjennom å våge, lede, lære, mobilisere og samarbeide. Dette er beskrevet i vår plattform for ledelse og medarbeiderskap, som vi har valgt å kalle for «Vi i Sarpsborg». Les hele plattformen «Vi i Sarpsborg her».

Over 60 000 innbyggere bor i Sarpsborg og hos oss i kommunen har vi cirka 6.900 fast ansatte og 4.200 årsverk (tall fra 2026). Her skal det være godt å bo, jobbe og besøke. Vil du søke jobb hos oss og være med på å utgjøre en forskjell for andre?

Sarpsborg kommune ønsker medarbeidere med ulik faglig, sosial, etnisk og geografisk bakgrunn. Dette inkluderer: ulik kompetanse, erfaring, oppvekstsvilkår, tro- og livssyn, perspektiv, nettverk, språk og dialekt, interesser, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering og kjønn- og kjønnsidentitet.  Vi trenger historier, stemmer og erfaringer fra hele befolkningen.

Alle søkere må vedlegge dokumentasjon på utdanning og attester på arbeidserfaring for å dokumentere kvalifikasjoner som fremkommer i CV og  som grunnlag til lønnsfastsettelse. Ansiennitet blir vurdert og fastsatt basert på vedlagt dokumentasjon.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Cybersecurity Challenges in Maritime AI
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming society, and the integration of AI into the maritime industry represents a digital shift that will redefine today’s operations. The maritime industry is increasingly embracing AI, enabling a broad digital transformation. At the same time, the use of AI introduce new cybersecurity challenges that need to be understood and addressed to enable secure and trustworthy AI technology.

This PhD project will investigate cybersecurity challenges associated with the development and use of AI in the maritime domain. The project will have an interdisciplinary approach, combining insights from information security, artificial intelligence, maritime operations, and data engineering. The research may address cybersecurity risks related to the data used to develop AI models, the models themselves, or their integration and use in maritime applications.

Relevant research topics may include cybersecurity risks related to training data and AI models, data poisoning and manipulation, privacy and confidentiality, secure data sharing, and methods for assessing the security and trustworthiness of maritime AI technology. The specific research questions and methodological approach will be further developed based on the candidate’s background and interests, relevant maritime AI use cases, and collaboration with industry partners.

This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and maritime operations in close collaboration with academic and industrial partners. The research is expected to contribute new knowledge and approaches for understanding and addressing cybersecurity challenges associated with the development and use of AI in the maritime domain.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

About the project

The candidate will work in a multidisciplinary research environment located at the heart of the maritime industry in Ålesund. Working at the NTNU department of ICT and Natural Sciences ensures close contact with the industry and research communities.

The PhD project will be part of the Norwegian Maritime AI Center that aims to accelerate operationalization of AI in the maritime value chains. The center shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control.

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: https://www.ntnu.edu/mai

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group Cyber-Physical Systems Laboratory (CPS Lab)
  • Participate in activities in the maritime AI center
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Participate in relevant dissemination activities for the industry

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant master’s degree in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, information security, maritime studies, marine technology, risk or safety management, human factors, engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • Written and oral fluency in English. Applicants with MSc degrees from institutions outside Europe are expected to document language proficiency. In extraordinary circumstances, formal documentation of language skills can be relinquished. In such cases, the candidate’s language skills will be assessed in a personal interview. 
  • The person hired must be eligible for security clearance at level CONFIDENTIAL or higher and be able to obtain such clearance within a reasonable period after employment. 

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) for general criteria for the position. 

Preferred selection criteria
  • Knowledge of the maritime industry
  • Knowledge of, or interest in, artificial intelligence (AI)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian equivalent level B2
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently and in research teams
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Good interpersonal skills that contribute to a friendly and inclusive work environment 

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page).
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work.
  • Possibly certificates.
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees. 

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Marie Haugli-Sandvik, email: marie.h.sandvik@ntnu.no or Rune Volden, email: rune.volden@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Silje Kjersem, email: silje.s.kjersem@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 19.11.2026

MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA-MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku

  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Developer Platform https://www.notion.com/product/dev engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion.


You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale.


This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

 - You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day.

 - You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions.

 - You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

 - Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

 - Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs

 - Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals

 - Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 – $200,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply.
